title: The 33
tagline: Hope Runs Deep
overview: Based on the true story of the collapse of a mine in San Jose, Chile—that left 33 miners isolated underground for 69 days.
plot:
The 33 (Spanish: Los 33) is a 2015 biographical survival drama directed by Patricia Riggen and written by Mikko Alanne, Craig Borten, Michael Thomas and José Rivera. Based on the 2010 Copiapó mining accident, in which 33 miners were trapped deep underground in the San José Mine in Chile for 69 days, it stars Antonio Banderas as the miner Mario Sepúlveda, with Rodrigo Santoro as Chilean mining minister Laurence Golborne, Juliette Binoche, James Brolin, Lou Diamond Phillips and Gabriel Byrne. It was released in Chile in August 2015 by 20th Century Fox and in the United States in November by Warner Bros. and Alcon Entertainment.

In August 2010, a group of miners are working in the San José gold and copper mine near Copiapó when a massive collapse seals off the only route to the surface. The disaster comes after the mine's owners ignored warnings about the instability of the mountain. Trapped more than 2,000 feet underground, the 33 men make their way to a small emergency refuge, only to find that it is badly stocked: the radio does not work, the medical supplies are missing and there is very little food.

Mario Sepúlveda, a charismatic miner, emerges as a leader, strictly rationing the meager supplies and working to keep the men united as fear, hunger and despair threaten to tear them apart, while the shift foreman Luis "Don Lucho" Urzúa, played by Phillips, struggles with guilt over having failed to prevent the disaster. On the surface, the mining company does little, and the miners' families set up a makeshift camp outside the gates, refusing to leave. Among them is María Segovia, played by Binoche, the determined sister of one of the trapped men. The Chilean government, led by Golborne, takes charge of the rescue, and engineers begin drilling in search of the refuge. After several boreholes miss, one finally breaks through, and the miners attach a note to the drill bit announcing that all 33 are alive. The film follows the long weeks that follow as rescuers work to bring every man to the surface.

The 33 received mixed reviews, with praise for its performances and its uplifting portrayal of the miners' resilience but criticism for its conventional approach. Although set in Chile, the film was shot largely in English with an international cast, a choice some critics questioned.

title: Deadpool
tagline: Witness the beginning of a happy ending.
overview: The origin story of former Special Forces operative turned mercenary Wade Wilson, who, after being subjected to a rogue experiment that leaves him with accelerated healing powers, adopts the alter ego Deadpool. Armed with his new abilities and a dark, twisted sense of humor, Deadpool hunts down the man who nearly destroyed his life.
plot:
Deadpool is a 2016 superhero film directed by Tim Miller, based on the Marvel Comics character of the same name. The movie follows the story of Wade Wilson, a former Special Forces operative turned mercenary, played by Ryan Reynolds.

Wade's life takes a drastic turn when he is diagnosed with terminal cancer. Desperate to find a cure, he seeks out a experimental treatment that promises to heal his cancer but also leaves him severely disfigured and mentally unstable. The treatment, known as the "Accelerated Healing Factor," makes Wade's body regenerate at an incredible rate, but it also drives him insane.

Wade becomes a mercenary for hire, using his newfound abilities to take on high-risk missions. He adopts the alter ego of Deadpool, a masked vigilante with a twisted sense of humor and a penchant for breaking the fourth wall. As he navigates the world as Deadpool, Wade struggles to maintain his sanity and find a cure for his condition.

Meanwhile, Ajax (Ed Skrein), a former Special Forces operative turned mercenary, is also seeking to exploit the Accelerated Healing Factor for his own gain. He kidnaps several women with the same genetic makeup as Wade, intending to use them as test subjects for his treatment. Deadpool sets out to rescue the women and take down Ajax.

Throughout the movie, Reynolds' performance brings a unique blend of humor, wit, and vulnerability to the character of Deadpool. The film's action sequences are fast-paced and intense, with plenty of clever references to comic book lore. The supporting cast, including Morena Baccarin as Vanessa Carlysle and T.J. Miller as Weasel, add depth and complexity to the story.

One of the standout aspects of Deadpool is its willingness to subvert traditional superhero movie tropes. The film's irreverent humor and self-awareness make it a refreshing change of pace from more conventional superhero fare. Reynolds' performance also allows for a level of emotional intimacy that is rare in comic book movies, making Deadpool feel like a character-driven story rather than just a superhero origin tale.

Overall, Deadpool is a wildly entertaining and visually stunning film that sets a new standard for the superhero genre. With its unique blend of humor, action, and heart, it's no wonder that the movie became a critical and commercial success, grossing over $782 million worldwide.

title: Kidnap
tagline: Vengeance is Mom
overview: A mother (in her Minivan) stops at nothing to recover her kidnapped son.
plot:
Kidnap is a 2017 American action thriller directed by Luis Prieto and written by Knate Lee. Halle Berry stars as Karla Dyson, a working mother who chases the people who abducted her young son, with Sage Correa as her son Frankie, Chris McGinn and Lew Temple as the kidnappers Margo and Terry Vickey, and Jason Winston George as Karla's estranged husband. Filmed in Louisiana in late 2014 on a budget of about 21 million dollars, it was delayed several times after its original distributor, Relativity Media, filed for bankruptcy in 2015, and it was eventually released by the newly founded Aviron Pictures in August 2017.

Karla is a waitress and a single mother involved in a custody dispute with her former husband. One afternoon she takes her six-year-old son Frankie to a carnival in a park. While she takes a phone call from her lawyer, Frankie vanishes, and Karla finds only his toy voice recorder. Rushing into the parking lot, she sees a woman forcing Frankie into a green Ford Mustang driven by a man.

Without her phone, which she dropped in the panic, Karla jumps into her minivan and gives chase. What follows is an almost continuous pursuit along the highways around New Orleans. The kidnappers try to shake her off by causing a multi-car pile-up and threaten to kill the boy with a knife. From Frankie's recorder, Karla learns that the woman's name is Margo. A motorcycle police officer she alerts is killed by the kidnappers, and Margo offers to return Frankie in exchange for ten thousand dollars. Karla refuses to give up, fighting off Margo in her own car, and she persists in following the kidnappers even when the police seem unable to help, eventually tracking them to their isolated home in the countryside, where she must confront them alone to rescue her son.

The film is built almost entirely around Berry's performance and the extended car chase, with little dialogue and a focus on a mother's determination to save her child at any cost.

Kidnap received mostly negative reviews, with an approval rating of about 35 percent on Rotten Tomatoes, although Berry's committed performance was frequently praised. It grossed about 34.8 million dollars worldwide, of which 31 million came from the United States and Canada.

title: The Age of Adaline
tagline: Love is timeless.
overview: After 29-year-old Adaline recovers from a nearly lethal accident, she inexplicably stops growing older. As the years stretch on and on, Adaline keeps her secret to herself  until she meets a man who changes her life.
plot:
The Age of Adaline is a 2015 American romantic drama film directed by Lee Toland Krieger, written by J. Mills Goodloe and Kelly Marcel, and produced by Lakeshore Entertainment.

The movie begins with Adaline Bowman (played by Blake Lively), a beautiful young woman who lives in the United States during World War II. On her 29th birthday, while walking home from work, she is hit by a car and suffers severe injuries that leave her clinically dead for 129 years. When Adaline awakens, she finds herself in the present day, but with no memory of her past life.

As Adaline tries to adjust to her new life, she meets Ellis Jones (played by Michiel Huisman), a charming and handsome man who becomes infatuated with her. However, their budding relationship is complicated by Adaline's mysterious past and her inability to remember anything before the car accident.

Throughout the film, Adaline struggles to come to terms with her immortality and the weight of living for centuries without aging. She has witnessed historical events unfold, including wars, assassinations, and social movements, but she is unable to form lasting connections with people due to her inability to remember their faces or their lives.

As Adaline navigates her new life, she meets William "Ellis" Jones (played by Michiel Huisman), a man who becomes her love interest. Despite the danger of revealing her true nature, Adaline finds herself falling for Ellis, but she is hesitant to open up to him due to her fear of losing him.

As their relationship deepens, Adaline must confront the consequences of her immortality and the secrets she has kept hidden for so long. She also begins to realize that her past is not just a series of random events, but a complex web of relationships and experiences that have shaped her into the person she is today.

The film's climax revolves around Adaline's decision to reveal her true nature to Ellis, who ultimately accepts her for who she is. The movie ends on a hopeful note, with Adaline finally able to form a lasting connection with someone and find a sense of belonging in the world.

Overall, The Age of Adaline is a beautifully crafted film that explores themes of love, loss, and identity. With its stunning visuals, engaging storyline, and memorable performances, it's no wonder this movie has captured the hearts of audiences worldwide.

title: Trumbo
tagline: Are you now or have you ever been...
overview: The career of screenwriter Dalton Trumbo is halted by a witch hunt in the late 1940s when he defies the anti-communist HUAC committee and is blacklisted.
plot:
Trumbo is a 2015 biographical drama film that delves into the life of Dalton Trumbo, a Hollywood screenwriter who was blacklisted in the 1950s due to his involvement with the Communist Party. The movie masterfully weaves together themes of artistic integrity, loyalty, and the struggle for redemption.

At its core, Trumbo is a story about the power of creative expression and the importance of staying true to one's values, even in the face of adversity. Dalton Trumbo, played by Bryan Cranston, is a talented screenwriter who finds himself at odds with the House Un-American Activities Committee (HUAC) and the Hollywood Blacklist. Despite being forced into silence, Trumbo continues to write, often under pseudonyms, and his work is eventually rediscovered by a young director, Kirk Douglas.

The film explores the tension between loyalty to one's country and loyalty to one's art. Trumbo's decision to cooperate with HUAC ultimately leads to his blacklisting, but it also allows him to continue writing and contributing to the film industry in meaningful ways. This internal conflict is reflected in the character of Trumbo himself, who struggles to reconcile his commitment to communism with his love of America and its ideals.

The movie also touches on the theme of redemption, as Trumbo seeks to clear his name and restore his reputation after years of silence. Through his relationships with those around him, including his wife, Christine (Helen Mirren), and his friend, Robert Aldrich (David Strathairn), Trumbo finds a way to reclaim his artistic voice and find forgiveness.

Overall, Trumbo is a powerful exploration of the human spirit, highlighting the importance of staying true to oneself and one's values, even in the face of adversity. The film is a testament to the enduring power of art and creativity, and the impact that individuals can have on society through their work.

title: Dinosaur Island
tagline: Their world is closer than you think.
overview: The adventure begins when Lucas, a 13 year old boy, embarks on the vacation of a lifetime. When disaster strikes, Lucas finds himself stranded in a strange land littered with ghost ships and prehistoric creatures. While searching for other signs of life, Lucas hears a radio broadcast in the distance and is drawn into the jungle where he encounters a beautiful young girl who claims to have come from the 1950s. Together they set out on a quest to get home all the while uncovering secrets that will forever change the future.
plot:
Dinosaur Island, released in the United Kingdom as Journey to Dinosaur Island, is a 2014 British-Australian family adventure film written and directed by Matt Drummond, with Jason Moody and Megan Williams as co-producers. It concerns a mysterious island where a special type of crystal acts as a portal, drawing in people and objects from different eras. Darius Williams stars as the 13-year-old Lucas Winton, with Kate Rasmussen as the young Kathryn, Juliette Palmer as her adult self, and Nicole Yardley, Paul Padagas and Joe Bistaveous in supporting roles.

Visiting his grandmother's old house, now up for sale, Lucas finds a crystal in a box on a bookshelf and pockets it. On a flight, he places it on the empty seat beside him, where it begins to glow; disaster strikes the plane, and Lucas wakes up stranded in a strange land strewn with ghost ships and roamed by prehistoric creatures. Following a distant radio broadcast into the jungle, he meets Kate, a girl who says she comes from the 1950s and once owned a crystal like his. She gives him her diary as a survival guide and introduces him to Mimos, a Sinornithosaurus that can mimic any sound, like a lyrebird. Lucas learns that mists appear during earthquakes and bring empty airplanes from different times, past and future, often loaded with useful supplies.

While investigating a newly arrived plane, the two are captured by tribespeople and locked in a wooden cage. A fellow prisoner recognises Lucas's crystal as a "sing sing stone" and explains that huge formations of it between the island's twin volcanoes create the mists. Lucas deduces that the cluster is a giant piezoelectric crystal set resonating by seismic activity, and that it could carry him home. The pair escape, catch a ride on a pterosaur Kate has freed, and survive a chase by a Tyrannosaurus, which Mimos scares away by imitating its roar, then outrun a pack of dromaeosaurs. In the cave between the volcanoes, Lucas uses a singing jar of water to activate the crystals. As the portal opens, Kate stays behind to retrieve her diary, promising to follow. Lucas wakes up in hospital and meets his grandmother Kathryn, who reveals that she is Kate, and who later wins a Nobel Prize with the evidence in her diary.

The film was released in Australian cinemas by Hoyts and United Cinemas in February 2015 and sold to more than 50 countries after its rights were acquired at Cannes in 2014.

As they near their destination, the group discovers that WICKED is behind the creation of the Maze and the Glade. The organization's true intentions are revealed to be sinister, and Thomas must confront the harsh reality of his existence.

The movie culminates in a thrilling showdown between Thomas and the leader of WICKED, Ava Paige (Patricia Clarkson). In a surprising twist, it is revealed that Ava is actually a clone of Teresa, created by WICKED as part of their experiment to create a super-soldier.

Overall, Maze Runner: The Scorch Trials is an action-packed and suspenseful film that explores themes of survival, loyalty, and the human condition.

title: All the Old Knives
tagline: Secrets kill.
overview: When the CIA discovers one of its agents leaked information that cost more than 100 people their lives, veteran operative Henry Pelham is assigned to root out the mole with his former lover and colleague Celia Harrison.
plot:
All the Old Knives is a 2022 American spy thriller directed by Janus Metz Pedersen and written by Olen Steinhauer, adapting his own 2015 novel. Chris Pine and Thandiwe Newton star as former CIA colleagues and lovers, with Laurence Fishburne, Jonathan Pryce, David Dawson and Corey Johnson. Amazon Studios released it in limited cinemas and on Prime Video on April 8, 2022.

In early 2020, CIA officer Henry Pelham is told by his chief at the Vienna station, Vick Wallinger, that the agency has reopened the case of Turkish Alliance Flight 127, a 2012 hijacking in Vienna that ended in disaster, because a mole in the station is suspected. Henry is sent to California to interview his former lover and colleague Celia Harrison, who abruptly left him and the agency after the hijacking and now lives with her husband and children in Carmel-by-the-Sea. They meet for dinner at an almost empty seaside restaurant.

In flashbacks, Islamist militants seize the plane on the runway and demand the release of prisoners. The station learns that a Chechen extremist, Ilyas Shishani, a former source whom Henry had once been forced to betray, may be involved. Ahmed, a CIA courier on board, sends messages suggesting an assault through the undercarriage, but Celia notices that their wording has changed and suspects he has been exposed, and finds a call to Iran from the office of her mentor, Bill Compton. Ahmed is murdered, and the hijackers eventually release sarin gas, killing everyone on board.

As the evening goes on, the conversation becomes a contest of wits. Celia reveals that she left because she saw the same Iranian number on Henry's phone and realised he was the leak, and that she has arranged this meeting to kill him: the diners and staff are fakes, and his wine has been poisoned, with the help of an Austrian intelligence officer, Karl Stein, and Vick. Dying, Henry confesses that Ilyas had threatened Celia's life, and that to save her he revealed the planned assault and Ahmed's presence. Celia tells him that the captured Ilyas had already named him. Henry accepts his fate, Celia returns to her family, and Vick is seen overseeing the clearing of Henry's apartment.

Critics were moderately positive, giving it 63% approval on Rotten Tomatoes and praising the chemistry between Pine and Newton.

title: Rise of the Legend
overview: In 1868 during the late Qing Dynasty, rampant corruption on the Imperial Court inflicts much suffering in people's lives. For years, the Black Tiger’s fearsome boss Lei Gong has been trying to get rid of the leader of the Northern Sea. One of his latest recruits is Fei, a fearless fighter who takes the Northern Sea leader’s head after a fierce fight. Just as Lei Gong believes he has total control of the port, a new gang called the Orphans rises in power. Led by Fei’s childhood friend Huo, the Orphans are out to eliminate all the criminal power from the port…
plot:
Rise of the Legend is a 2014 Hong Kong-Chinese kung fu action film directed by Roy Chow from a screenplay by Christine To, offering an origin story for the folk hero Wong Fei-hung. Eddie Peng plays the young Wong, leading an ensemble that includes Sammo Hung, Wang Luodan, Jing Boran, Max Zhang, Wong Cho-lam, Angelababy and Tony Leung Ka-fai. It opened in China in November 2014.

The story is set in Guangzhou in 1868, during the late Qing dynasty, where control of the Huangpu port is split between two criminal organisations, the Black Tiger gang and the Northern Sea gang. Master Lui, the ruthless head of the Black Tiger, has long wanted the rival boss eliminated. That task falls to a new recruit, the 21-year-old Wong Fei-hung, who defeats and beheads the Northern Sea leader in a ferocious duel. Impressed, Lui adopts Wong as his godson and elevates him to the Four Tigers, the inner circle of the gang's most trusted enforcers.

Wong, however, is not what he seems. He has infiltrated the Black Tiger to destroy it from within, working with childhood friends on the outside: Fiery, who secretly adores their friend Chun; Chun herself, Wong's sweetheart; the ally Foon; and Big Tooth, a former gang member who joins the mission. Inside the gang, Wong and Chun kill Black Crow, another of the Four Tigers, to obtain his key to the gang's bank vault. Wong also learns that the courtesan Xiao Hua is a childhood friend he had long lost track of. Wu Long, the son of the slain Northern Sea leader, seeks revenge against the Black Tiger, and Lui kills him even as Wong tries to spare his life. The mission exacts a heavy toll: Fiery sacrifices himself to keep Wong's role as a mole from being exposed, and Xiao Hua dies near the end while helping him in her own way. Tony Leung Ka-fai appears as Wong's father, Wong Kei-ying, a martial artist and physician who died in a fire started by a villain while saving his disciples. As the truth about the young man's past comes out, the conflict heads toward a final confrontation with Lui.

The project was announced in August 2013 by Edko Films, Irresistible Delta and BDI Films, with William Kong, Liu Erdong and Ivy Ho producing. Principal photography started in China on 20 August 2013 and wrapped in mid-December. In June 2014 Universal Pictures International acquired the international rights, including North America, while Edko handled distribution in Asia.

title: Patient Zero
overview: After an unprecedented global pandemic has turned the majority of humankind into violent infected beings, Morgan, a man gifted with the ability to speak the infected's new language, leads the last survivors on a hunt for patient zero and a cure.
plot:
Patient Zero is a 2018 apocalyptic thriller film that delves into the theme of isolation and the blurred lines between humanity and savagery. The movie follows a lone survivor, Robert Neville, who finds himself immune to a deadly virus that has turned most of humanity into violent, zombie-like creatures.

As the story unfolds, the film explores the psychological effects of isolation on Neville's character, as he struggles to maintain his grip on sanity while navigating a desolate world devoid of human connection. The movie raises questions about what it means to be human and whether our relationships with others are essential to our survival.

The film also touches on the theme of loneliness, highlighting the devastating consequences of losing loved ones and being forced to confront the reality of one's own mortality. Neville's character is a poignant representation of this theme, as he grapples with the weight of his isolation and the moral implications of his actions in a world that has been ravaged by the virus.

Furthermore, Patient Zero critiques the notion of humanity's reliance on technology and societal structures to survive. In a post-apocalyptic world where these systems have failed, Neville is forced to rely on his wits and resourcefulness to stay alive, highlighting the importance of individual resilience in the face of catastrophic collapse.

Overall, Patient Zero presents a gripping narrative that explores the darker aspects of human nature, isolation, and the consequences of our actions in the face of unimaginable adversity.

title: Monkey Kingdom
tagline: Adventure is in Full Swing.
overview: A newborn monkey and its mother struggle to survive within the competitive social hierarchy of the Temple Troop, a dynamic group of monkeys who live in ancient ruins found deep in the storied jungles of South Asia.
plot:
Monkey Kingdom is a 2015 documentary film directed by Mark Linfield and produced by Disneynature. The film follows the lives of a troop of rhesus macaques in India, exploring their social dynamics, behavior, and struggles.

At its core, Monkey Kingdom delves into the themes of community, cooperation, and the complexities of social hierarchy within the troop. The documentary showcases how these intelligent primates work together to survive, often putting the needs of the group above individual desires. This is exemplified through the character of Akbar, a dominant male who must balance his own ambitions with the well-being of his troop.

The film also touches on the theme of environmentalism, highlighting the impact of human activities on the monkeys' habitat and way of life. The destruction of their forest home due to deforestation and urbanization serves as a stark reminder of the delicate balance between nature and humanity.

Furthermore, Monkey Kingdom explores the concept of identity and individuality within the troop. As the characters navigate their social roles and relationships, they must also contend with their own desires and aspirations. This is particularly evident in the character of Akbar's daughter, who begins to assert her independence and challenge the traditional norms of her family.

Throughout the film, these themes are woven together to create a nuanced portrayal of life within a primate troop. The documentary offers a thought-provoking examination of the intricate social dynamics at play, inviting viewers to reflect on their own relationships with others and the natural world.

title: The Boss Baby
tagline: Born leader
overview: A story about how a new baby's arrival impacts a family, told from the point of view of a delightfully unreliable narrator, a wildly imaginative 7 year old named Tim.
plot:
The Boss Baby is a computer-animated comedy film produced by DreamWorks Animation. The movie was released on February 18, 2017.

In a world where babies are born with their own unique talents and abilities, the story revolves around Tim Templeton (voiced by Miles Bakshi), a 7-year-old boy who feels like an outcast among his peers. He is constantly belittled and bullied by his older brother, Jimmy (voiced by Noah Schnapp).

One day, while on a family vacation in New York City, Tim discovers that he has a long-lost twin brother, Francis E. Francis (voiced by Alec Baldwin), who was born as part of a secret government experiment to create the perfect baby. Francis is a high-ranking executive at Puppy Co., a toy company owned by Bob the Golden Retriever (voiced by Steve Buscemi).

Francis is sent to Earth to take over Tim's life and eliminate him, but things don't go according to plan. Francis is initially confused about his surroundings and struggles to adjust to human life. He also discovers that he has a unique talent for business and leadership.

As Francis navigates his new environment, he forms an unlikely bond with Tim, who helps him understand the value of family and friendship. Meanwhile, Francis's presence in Tim's life causes chaos, leading to a series of hilarious and action-packed events.

The plot thickens when Francis discovers that Puppy Co. is being threatened by a rival company, Puppy Corp., led by the villainous Baby Corpse (voiced by Jimmy Kimmel). Francis must use his business skills to save Puppy Co. and prove himself as a valuable member of the family.

Throughout the movie, Tim and Francis learn valuable lessons about sibling rivalry, loyalty, and the importance of embracing their unique qualities. The film features a talented voice cast, witty humor, and stunning animation that brings the characters to life.

In the end, Francis successfully saves Puppy Co., and he and Tim form an unbreakable bond. The movie concludes with a heartwarming moment where Francis finally understands what it means to be part of a family and finds his place in the world.

Overall, The Boss Baby is a fun and entertaining film that explores themes of identity, family, and acceptance. With its lovable characters, engaging storyline, and stunning animation, it's no wonder why this movie became a box office hit.

title: Attack on Titan
original_title: 進撃の巨人 ATTACK ON TITAN
tagline: The face of humanity's extinction.
overview: 100 years ago, titans suddenly appeared on Earth. Soon, human civilization veered on collapse due to the titans. Humans then built a giant wall to defend themselves. Within the giant walls, humans lived in peace, but, 100 years later, the giant wall is broken.
plot:
Attack on Titan is a 2015 Japanese post-apocalyptic action film directed by Shinji Higuchi and written by Yūsuke Watanabe and Tomohiro Machiyama, the first of two live-action films based on Hajime Isayama's manga. At Isayama's suggestion, the story moves its setting to an analogue of Japan and adds new characters. Haruma Miura stars as Eren, with Kiko Mizuhara as Mikasa, Kanata Hongō as Armin, Hiroki Hasegawa as Captain Shikishima, Pierre Taki as Souda, Jun Kunimura as Kubal, Satomi Ishihara as Hange and Nanami Sakuraba as Sasha.

A century ago, giant humanoid Titans appeared and wiped out most of humanity, and the survivors walled themselves in to live in peace. In the village of Monzen, Eren tells his friends Armin and Mikasa that he longs to see the world beyond the Outer Wall, and after a failed attempt to approach it, the Garrison captain Souda tells them that the military is forming a scouting regiment to explore outside. Suddenly the Colossal Titan breaches the wall, and Titans pour into the village, devouring people and regenerating whenever they are wounded. While trying to save a baby, Mikasa is separated from Eren and presumed dead. Two years later, Eren and Armin join the Scout Regiment along with Sasha, Jean and others, led by Kubal, they set out for a town inside the Outer Wall. Attacked by Titans, they are rescued by Captain Shikishima and by Mikasa, who survived and has joined the Scouts but now treats Eren like a stranger. She tells him that the disaster taught her how cruel the world is, and Eren is crushed to realize that she is probably with Shikishima. When more Titans strike, Kubal retreats and leaves the Scouts to fend for themselves. Lil, who has just lost her lover, sacrifices herself, and Eren, refusing Jean's pleas to flee, loses an arm and is swallowed while saving Armin. A grief-stricken Mikasa fights on until her gear runs low on fuel and she faces the Titan that ate Eren, when a new Titan bursts out of it and begins battling the others. Souda and Mikasa realize that it is Eren, and as it collapses, Mikasa pulls him free from the Titan's body.

After a world premiere at the Egyptian Theatre in Los Angeles on 14 July 2015, the film opened in Japan on 1 August, followed by the second part, End of the World, in September. It topped the Japanese box office on its opening weekend and grossed ¥3.25 billion. Critics were mixed, praising the Titan designs and B-movie style while faulting the script and departures from the manga.

title: Burnt
tagline: Never underestimate a man with everything to lose.
overview: Adam Jones is a Chef who destroyed his career with drugs and diva behavior. He cleans up and returns to London, determined to redeem himself by spearheading a top restaurant that can gain three Michelin stars.
plot:
Burnt is a 2015 comedy-drama directed by John Wells and written by Steven Knight from a story by Michael Kalesniko. Bradley Cooper stars as Adam Jones, with Sienna Miller as Helene, Daniel Brühl as Tony, Omar Sy as Michel, Matthew Rhys as Reece, Alicia Vikander as Anne Marie, Uma Thurman as the critic Simone and Emma Thompson as Dr. Rosshilde.

Adam was once a two-Michelin-star chef in Paris, but drugs and his temper destroyed his career and his mentor Jean-Luc's restaurant. He sobers up in New Orleans by shucking a million oysters and then arrives in London determined to win a third star. He finds Tony Balerdi, Jean-Luc's former maître d', now managing a London hotel. He also tracks down old colleagues, including Michel, whose restaurant he once sabotaged, and Max, who is just out of prison. Adam arranges for the influential critic Simone to dine at the hotel, and her positive review persuades Tony to rebuild the kitchen and hire Adam on the condition that he submits to weekly drug tests with Dr. Rosshilde. Adam recruits the talented sous-chef Helene by tripling her pay.

Adam bullies his staff without mercy, and a disastrous opening night ends with him humiliating Helene, who quits. Tony persuades her to come back. The relaunch earns good reviews and annoys Adam's rival, Montgomery Reece, and Adam gradually softens, even baking a birthday cake for Helene's daughter, Lily. Then his past catches up with him. He meets his former girlfriend Anne Marie, Jean-Luc's daughter, whom he had abandoned, and enforcers for his old dealer beat him up over an unpaid debt. When two diners he believes are Michelin inspectors arrive, Michel ruins their dishes with cayenne pepper in revenge and leaves. Adam gets drunk and goes to Reece, who comforts him. He then learns that Anne Marie has paid his debt and that the diners were not inspectors after all. Opening up to Helene and finally trusting his team, Adam leads the kitchen through the real inspection, and the restaurant earns its third star.

The Weinstein Company released Burnt on October 30, 2015. Jamie Dornan's scenes were cut during editing. It opened with only $5 million and grossed $36.6 million worldwide against a $20 million budget. Critics praised Cooper but criticized the script. Rotten Tomatoes' consensus described a few spoonfuls of compelling culinary drama lost in a watery goulash of cliché and an unsavory lead.

title: Me Before You
tagline: Live boldly.
overview: A small town girl is caught between dead-end jobs. A high-profile, successful man becomes wheelchair bound following an accident. The man decides his life is not worth living until the girl is hired for six months to be his new caretaker. Worlds apart and trapped together by circumstance, the two get off to a rocky start. But the girl becomes determined to prove to the man that life is worth living and as they embark on a series of adventures together, each finds their world changing in ways neither of them could begin to imagine.
plot:
Me Before You is a 2016 romantic drama directed by Thea Sharrock in her feature directorial debut and adapted by Jojo Moyes from her own 2012 novel. It stars Emilia Clarke as Louisa "Lou" Clark and Sam Claflin as Will Traynor, with Janet McTeer and Charles Dance as Will's parents, Brendan Coyle as Lou's father and Matthew Lewis as her boyfriend Patrick. It was filmed at historic locations across the United Kingdom, including Pembroke Castle in Wales and Chenies Manor House in Buckinghamshire.

In the small English town of Stokebridge, Lou Clark, a cheerful and quirky young woman who needs money to support her family, accepts a six-month position as a caregiver for Will Traynor. Will is a wealthy former banker and adventurous sportsman who became quadriplegic after being hit by a motorcycle two years earlier. Embittered and depressed, he treats Lou coldly at first, and his ex-girlfriend's announcement that she is marrying his former best friend only deepens his despair.

Lou perseveres, and the two gradually grow close as Will introduces her to films, music and ideas beyond the confines of her small-town life, encouraging her to be more ambitious. By chance, Lou learns that Will has agreed to give his parents six months before travelling to Switzerland to end his life through assisted suicide. Determined to change his mind, she plans a series of outings and adventures to show him that life is still worth living. As her relationship with her boyfriend Patrick falls apart, Lou and Will fall in love, culminating in a trip to Mauritius. But Will's decision remains firm, forcing Lou to confront the limits of love and the meaning of respecting another person's choices.

The film's portrayal of disability and assisted suicide drew criticism from many disability rights activists, who argued that it implied that the lives of disabled people are not worth living, and protests were held at several screenings.

Me Before You was released on 3 June 2016 and was a commercial success, grossing about 208.4 million dollars worldwide against a 20 million dollar budget. Reviews were mixed, with 55 percent approval on Rotten Tomatoes and a Metacritic score of 51, although the performances of Clarke and Claflin were praised.

title: Bridge of Spies
tagline: In the shadow of war, one man showed the world what we stood for.
overview: During the Cold War, the Soviet Union captures U.S. pilot Francis Gary Powers after shooting down his U-2 spy plane. Sentenced to 10 years in prison, Powers' only hope is New York lawyer James Donovan, recruited by a CIA operative to negotiate his release. Donovan boards a plane to Berlin, hoping to win the young man's freedom through a prisoner exchange. If all goes well, the Russians would get Rudolf Abel, the convicted spy who Donovan defended in court.
plot:
Bridge of Spies is a 2015 historical drama film directed and co-produced by Steven Spielberg from a screenplay by Matt Charman and the Coen brothers. Tom Hanks stars as the American lawyer James B. Donovan, with Mark Rylance, Amy Ryan and Alan Alda. Set during the Cold War, it dramatizes how Donovan, after defending a Soviet spy in court, was entrusted with negotiating the exchange of that spy for the American pilot Francis Gary Powers. The title refers to the Glienicke Bridge between Potsdam and Berlin, where the exchange took place.

In New York in 1957, Rudolf Abel is arrested and charged with spying for the Soviet Union. Donovan, a former general counsel of the Office of Strategic Services now working in insurance law, is appointed to defend him. Believing that every accused person deserves a real defense, he takes the job seriously, refuses the CIA's attempts to get him to breach his client's confidentiality and gradually builds a mutual respect with Abel. Although Abel is convicted, Donovan persuades the judge to spare his life, arguing that the spy may one day prove valuable in a prisoner exchange, and he takes an appeal all the way to the Supreme Court, which narrowly upholds the conviction. His principled stand makes him deeply unpopular, and his family is harassed, including shots fired into their home. In 1960 Powers, a pilot in the CIA's secret U-2 program, is shot down over the Soviet Union and imprisoned. When a letter purportedly from Abel's wife arrives, the CIA reads it as a signal that Moscow is ready to trade, and Donovan is sent, unofficially, to Berlin just as the Wall is going up. In East Berlin he must negotiate with a KGB officer and with Vogel, a lawyer representing the East German government, which holds an American graduate student, Frederic Pryor, and wants to use him to win recognition from the United States. Against the CIA's wishes, Donovan insists on bringing home both Powers and Pryor in exchange for Abel, staking the entire deal on a bluff.

Bridge of Spies received critical acclaim for its screenplay, Spielberg's direction, the performances of Hanks and Rylance, Thomas Newman's score and its production values. plot:
The Night Before is a 2015 American Christmas comedy film directed by Jonathan Levine and written by Jonah Hill and Andrew Cohen. The movie stars Seth Rogen, Joseph Gordon-Levitt, Anthony Mackie, Danny McBride, and Jillian Bell.

The trio grew up together in New York City, but as they've grown older, they've drifted apart. They're all facing different challenges in their lives, from Evan's failed business venture to Chris's unfulfilling job.

The friends decide to embark on a Christmas Eve adventure to relive their childhood memories and recapture the magic of their youth. Their plan is to visit three iconic locations: the Empire State Building, the New York Public Library, and the Rockefeller Center Christmas tree. Along the way, they encounter various misadventures, including run-ins with eccentric characters, wild parties, and unexpected romantic entanglements.

As the night progresses, Evan becomes increasingly obsessed with finding a rare and expensive bottle of scotch, which he believes will be the perfect gift for his estranged father. Chris, on the other hand, is trying to reconnect with his high school sweetheart, who has recently moved back to New York. Billy, meanwhile, is struggling to come to terms with his own identity and sense of purpose.

Throughout their journey, the friends face numerous challenges, including a wild goose chase through Manhattan, a run-in with a group of rough-looking men, and a heart-to-heart conversation about growing up and moving on. Along the way, they also encounter a series of hilarious and memorable characters, including a eccentric old man (Morgan Freeman) who becomes their guide for the night.

As the night wears on, the friends begin to confront their own personal demons and insecurities. Evan must face his complicated relationship with his father, Chris must come to terms with his past mistakes, and Billy must learn to let go of his need for control. Through a series of comedic misadventures and heartfelt moments, the trio ultimately learns to reconnect with each other and find their way back to their childhood roots.

The movie ends on a hopeful note, with the friends reunited and ready to face the challenges of adulthood together. As they stand at the top of the Empire State Building, looking out over the city, they share a moment of quiet reflection and newfound appreciation for each other's company. The Night Before is a heartwarming and hilarious holiday film that explores the complexities of male friendship and the power of nostalgia to bring people back together.

title: Deepwater Horizon

overview: A story set on the offshore drilling rig Deepwater Horizon, which exploded during April 2010 and created the worst oil spill in U.S. history.
plot:
Deepwater Horizon is a 2016 American biographical disaster film directed by Peter Berg and written by Matthew Michael Carnahan, Matthew Robbins, and Billy Ray. The film is based on the true story of the Deepwater Horizon oil spill, which occurred on April 20, 2010.

The movie begins with Mike Williams (played by Mark Wahlberg), a young and ambitious oil rig worker who has just been hired to work on the Deepwater Horizon, an offshore drilling platform located in the Gulf of Mexico. The film then cuts to the present day, where we see Mike as a single father living in Houston, Texas.

Mike is struggling to make ends meet after his daughter's death in a car accident, and he sees this new job as an opportunity to provide for her. He reunites with his old flame, Andrea Fleytas (played by Kate Hudson), who has become a nurse at the hospital where Mike works.

As Mike begins working on the Deepwater Horizon, we see him quickly rise through the ranks due to his exceptional skills and work ethic. However, tensions begin to rise among the crew as they face numerous challenges, including equipment failures and disagreements with their superiors.

On April 20, 2010, a catastrophic explosion occurs on the rig, killing 11 workers and injuring many more. The film then cuts to the aftermath of the disaster, where we see Mike's efforts to help rescue his fellow crew members and find out what caused the explosion.

As the investigation into the disaster unfolds, it becomes clear that the rig was not properly maintained, and that BP (British Petroleum) had been aware of the risks associated with drilling in the Gulf. The film then cuts to a series of courtroom scenes, where we see Mike testifying against BP, along with other crew members.

Throughout the film, we see flashbacks of the events leading up to the explosion, as well as the aftermath and the subsequent trial. We also see the personal struggles that Mike faces as he tries to come to terms with his daughter's death and find a way to move forward.

The film ends with Mike finally finding closure, having testified against BP and helped bring about justice for the victims of the disaster. The final scene shows Mike reunited with Andrea and their daughter, who has been adopted by another family after her original parents' death.

Overall, Deepwater Horizon is a powerful and emotional film that tells an important story about the human cost of corporate greed and negligence. Mark Wahlberg delivers a strong performance as Mike Williams, bringing depth and nuance to the character. The film's attention to detail and commitment to accuracy make it a compelling watch for anyone interested in true stories or disaster films.

title: Finders Keepers
tagline: No soul is safe
overview: A haunted doll teaches one little girl why children shouldn't play with undead things.
plot:
Finders Keepers is a 2014 American supernatural horror television film directed by Alexander Yellen. Written by Peter Sullivan from a story by Jeffrey Schenck and Sullivan, it was produced by HFD Productions and Hybrid, with a score by Matthew Janszen, and premiered on the Syfy channel on 18 October 2014 before being distributed on home video by Lionsgate. It runs about 85 minutes and stars Jaime Pressly, Kylie Rogers, Patrick Muldoon and Tobin Bell, its premise summed up by the warning that children should not play with undead things.

The film opens with two police officers entering a house where a family has been murdered; inside, they are attacked and killed by the family's knife-wielding son, Zachary. Five years later, newly separated from her husband Jonathan (Muldoon), Alyson Simon (Pressly) moves into the large old house in the countryside with her nine-year-old daughter Claire (Rogers). The estate agent has kept the killings secret, and Alyson only learns of them after the move. Exploring the house, Claire finds a doll left behind by the previous occupants and soon develops a dangerous obsession with it.

Claire's behaviour grows increasingly disturbing, and deaths begin to pile up, starting with the apparent suicide of Jonathan's new girlfriend during one of Claire's visits. Alyson visits Zachary in a psychiatric institution in search of answers, learning nothing before he later escapes. Every attempt to get rid of the doll fails, as it keeps returning to Claire, and a voodoo-like bond forms between them, so that whatever happens to one happens to the other. Claire's therapist, Dr. Freeman (Bell), mistakes the injuries she suffers when her parents try to destroy the toy for signs of abuse, but is killed after realising she lied. Alyson's friend Elena Carranza (Justina Machado), a professor who studies the paranormal, takes the doll to her laboratory and suggests that removing its eyes will break the connection, but she too falls victim to the possessed girl. In a final struggle at the house, Jonathan gouges out the doll's eyes and breaks the curse, and the reconciled parents decide to sell the house and give their marriage another chance.

The cast also includes Marina Sirtis, Mark DeCarlo and Joey Luthman as the adult Zachary. German-language reviews found the film lacking in suspense and derivative of Sinister and Child's Play, praising the performances of Rogers and Bell but less impressed by Pressly and the dialogue.

title: XX
tagline: Four deadly tales by four killer women
overview: This all-female horror anthology features four dark tales from four fiercely talented women.
plot:
XX is a 2017 American horror anthology film made up of four segments, each written or directed by a woman: Jovanka Vuckovic, Annie Clark (the musician known as St. Vincent, in her directorial debut), Roxanne Benjamin and Karyn Kusama. Natalie Brown, Melanie Lynskey, Breeda Wool and Christina Kirk head the ensemble. The stories are tied together by stop-motion interludes created by Sofia Carrillo, in which a living dollhouse with a blinking doll's face roams about collecting objects, aided by a detached doll's hand, until it finds a small blackbird and places it inside the chest of a sleeping girl, who then wakes.

In "The Box", adapted by Vuckovic from a Jack Ketchum story, a boy named Danny peeks into a red gift box held by a stranger on a train and afterwards refuses to eat. His sister and then his father, after Danny whispers something to them, stop eating too, while his mother Susan is tormented by a dream of her family devouring her. By Christmas the three are emaciated, and Susan later reveals that they all starved to death; she now rides the trains looking for the man with the box.

In "The Birthday Party", directed by Clark from a script she wrote with Benjamin, a mother named Mary finds her husband dead in his study on the morning of her daughter Lucy's birthday party and, rather than call for help, spends the day frantically hiding the body, eventually stuffing it into a rented panda costume, with predictably disastrous results in front of the young guests.

In Benjamin's "Don't Fall", four friends camping in the desert come across an ancient rock painting of an evil spirit; that night a creature possesses one of them, Gretchen, and hunts down the others. In Kusama's "Her Only Living Son", conceived as an unofficial sequel to Rosemary's Baby, a woman calling herself Cora has raised her son Andy in hiding, and as he nears his eighteenth birthday she watches him reveal his true nature as the child of Satan.

The project was announced in 2014 with a different line-up of directors, two of whom left before production. XX premiered at the Sundance Film Festival in January 2017 and was released in select theaters and on demand by Magnet Releasing. Reviews were generally favorable: critics praised the range of female voices and the strongest segments, while some noted that the short running times left little room for character development and that the overall quality was uneven, a common problem in anthologies.

Through PK's journey, the film highlights the tension between rationality and superstition, as well as the dangers of blindly following dogma without questioning its validity. Ultimately, PK (2014) is a movie that challenges viewers to think critically about their own beliefs and values, and to question the status quo in pursuit of truth and understanding.

title: The Scorpion King 4: Quest for Power

overview: When he is betrayed by a trusted friend, Mathayus must marshal all his strength and cunning to outwit a formidable opponent who will stop at nothing to unlock a supreme ancient power.
plot:
The Scorpion King 4: Quest for Power is a 2015 direct-to-video sword-and-sorcery action adventure directed by Mike Elliott and the fourth installment in The Scorpion King series. Victor Webster returns as Mathayus, with Ellen Hollman, Will Kemp, Barry Bostwick, Lou Ferrigno, Rutger Hauer, Royce Gracie and Eve Torres in supporting roles. It was released on home media on January 6, 2015.

Mathayus and his partner Drazen infiltrate a palace to steal an artifact called the Urn of Kings for King Zakkour of Al-Moraad, but Drazen betrays him and escapes with the urn. Sent by Zakkour to the northern kingdom of Norvania to deliver a peace treaty, Mathayus discovers that Drazen is the son of its ruler, King Yannick, who shatters the urn to retrieve the Golden Key of Lord Alcaman, an ancient sorcerer who once ruled the known world. The inscription on the key holds the secret to his power. Mathayus allows himself to be arrested to get inside the castle and meets Valina Raskov, a fierce prisoner from the kingdom's original royal bloodline whom Drazen intends to execute publicly to cement his father's rule.

Yannick believes Mathayus's peace mission and releases him, but Drazen assassinates his father with scorpions and frames Mathayus. Before dying, Yannick passes the key to Mathayus, who escapes with Valina. The pair seek out her father, Sorrell, a scholar and inventor who has no wish to reclaim the throne. He deciphers the inscription, which points to a hidden palace containing Alcaman's crown, an artifact that will grant its wearer power over the world. Drazen seizes the key and leaves them to die in a burning house, but the heroes survive and follow him through a series of villages, temples and traps. In the final confrontation inside the mountain, Drazen is destroyed by the crown's power, and Mathayus uses it to save Sorrell. The heroes seal the key and crown away and declare Alcaman's power a myth. Sorrell is restored to the throne but passes the crown to Valina, who vows to build a kingdom founded on science and reason with just a little bit of magic, and Zakkour releases Mathayus to stay at her side.

The film continued the series' tradition of lighthearted fantasy adventure, mixing martial arts, humor and cameos from genre veterans. A fifth film, The Scorpion King: Book of Souls, followed in 2018 with Zach McGowan replacing Webster.

plot:
Justice League: Throne of Atlantis is a 2015 American animated superhero film directed by Ethan Spaulding and written by Heath Corson, the 22nd entry in the DC Universe Animated Original Movies line and a standalone sequel to Justice League: War. Loosely based on the Throne of Atlantis story arc from The New 52 by Geoff Johns, it features Matt Lanter as Arthur Curry, Sumalee Montano as Mera, Sam Witwer as Orm, Jason O'Mara as Batman, Jerry O'Connell as Superman, Rosario Dawson as Wonder Woman, Nathan Fillion as Green Lantern, Christopher Gorham as the Flash, Shemar Moore as Cyborg, Sean Astin as Shazam and Harry Lennix as Black Manta.

When the crew of the nuclear submarine USS California is mysteriously killed in the Atlantic and its missiles are stolen, Cyborg and the Justice League investigate and determine that the attackers came from Atlantis. In the undersea kingdom, Prince Orm argues for war against the surface world, which he blames for his father's death, while his mother, Queen Atlanna, opposes him and sends the warrior Mera to bring her other son, Arthur Curry, to Atlantis.

Arthur, a loner living on the surface who is unaware of his heritage, survives an attack by Atlantean soldiers when Mera rescues him. Meanwhile Black Manta, secretly allied with Orm, uses the stolen missiles to strike Atlantis in a vessel disguised as a Navy submarine, framing humanity. Outraged Atlanteans demand war, and as Arthur learns that he is half-Atlantean and heir to the throne, Orm's schemes grow more treacherous. Batman and Superman, who have uncovered Arthur's origin, join Arthur and Mera as the conflict escalates into an invasion of the surface. With the Justice League caught in the middle, Arthur must embrace his identity and claim the mystical trident to stop his half-brother from triggering a war between land and sea.

The film functions as an origin story for Aquaman, focusing on his discovery of his dual identity and his struggle to bridge two worlds.

It was released digitally on January 13, 2015, and on Blu-ray and DVD on January 27. Reviews were mixed, with a 57 percent rating on Rotten Tomatoes; Forbes felt it retread familiar ground, while Variety argued that it showed DC consistently outclassing Marvel in animation.

The protagonist, Toby Grisoni (played by Jonathan Pryce), is a filmmaker who becomes obsessed with recreating the world of Don Quixote for his movie. As he navigates this fictional realm, he begins to lose touch with reality, blurring the lines between what's real and what's not.

The film also explores the theme of identity and how it can be shaped by our experiences, relationships, and societal expectations. Toby Grisoni is a complex character who struggles with his own sense of self, feeling disconnected from the world around him. His journey becomes a metaphor for the search for meaning and purpose in life.

Furthermore, The Man Who Killed Don Quixote touches on the idea of nostalgia and how it can be both a bittersweet and redemptive force. Toby's obsession with recreating the past is driven by his desire to recapture lost love and experiences, but ultimately leads him down a path of self-discovery and transformation.

Throughout the film, Gilliam's signature visual style and sense of humor add depth and complexity to the narrative, making it a thought-provoking exploration of the human experience.

The Joker's presence causes tension among the team members, particularly between Deadshot and Harley Quinn.

Similarly, El Diablo's pyromania is revealed to be a result of his abusive childhood.

In the climactic final battle, the team faces off against the Enchantress and her minions. The Joker also makes an appearance, causing chaos and destruction throughout the city. In the end, the team manages to defeat the Enchantress and destroy the Mother Box, saving the world from destruction.

However, the movie ends on a bittersweet note as Harley Quinn is left alone, still struggling with her mental health issues. The Joker's fate is also left uncertain, leaving room for speculation about his future appearances in the DC Extended Universe.

Overall, Suicide Squad received mixed reviews from critics but was a commercial success, grossing over $745 million worldwide. Despite its flaws, the movie introduced several new characters to the DC Extended Universe and set the stage for future films featuring the team.

title: Wonder Woman

overview: An Amazon princess comes to the world of Man in the grips of the First World War to confront the forces of evil and bring an end to human conflict.
plot:
Wonder Woman is a 2017 superhero film directed by Patty Jenkins, produced by Charles Roven, Deborah Snyder, and Donna Simpson, and distributed by Warner Bros. Pictures.

The film begins with Diana Prince (Gal Gadot) as a young girl growing up on Themyscira, an island inhabited by the Amazons, a tribe of warrior women. Diana's mother, Queen Hippolyta (Connie Nielsen), is the ruler of the Amazons and trains her daughter in combat and wisdom.

As Diana grows older, she begins to question the traditional ways of her people and longs for adventure beyond their shores. She discovers a plane that has crashed on Themyscira, carrying Steve Trevor (Chris Pine), an American pilot who has been rescued by the Amazons.

Steve tells Hippolyta about the war between Germany and the Allies during World War I, which is ongoing in the outside world. Diana decides to accompany Steve back to the world of men, where she hopes to find a way to stop the war and bring peace to the people.

Upon arrival in No Man's Land, Diana meets Steve and together they try to escape the battlefield. However, they are soon captured by German forces led by General Erich Ludendorff (Danny Huston) and Doctor Maru (Elena Anaya), who is revealed to be a skilled Amazonian warrior.

Diana uses her combat skills to fight off the German soldiers, but she is eventually taken prisoner. Steve manages to escape and returns to Diana's cell, where he finds her being held captive by Ludendorff.

As Diana tries to escape from her captors, she discovers that Doctor Maru has been experimenting on herself using a magical artifact known as the Lasso of Truth. The Lasso forces people to tell the truth, but it also slowly drives them mad.

Diana and Steve hatch a plan to stop Ludendorff's plans for an Amazonian army to be used in the war effort. They infiltrate Ludendorff's headquarters, where Diana confronts Maru and breaks her free from the Lasso's control.

In the final battle, Diana faces off against Ludendorff and his forces. She uses her combat skills and the magic of the Lasso to defeat them, saving Steve and stopping the war.

As the war comes to an end, Diana returns to Themyscira, where she is welcomed back as a hero. However, she realizes that there is more to being a warrior than just fighting, and she begins to question her own identity and purpose.

The film ends with Diana standing on the beach, looking out at the sea, symbolizing her newfound sense of self and her commitment to using her powers for good in the world beyond Themyscira.

plot:
Aquaman is a 2018 superhero film directed by James Wan and produced by Warner Bros. Pictures. The movie follows the story of Arthur Curry, also known as Aquaman, played by Jason Momoa.

The film begins with a prologue that shows the origin story of Atlantis, an underwater kingdom ruled by King Orm (Patrick Wilson), who seeks to conquer the surface world and destroy it in order to save his own people from the pollution and destruction caused by humans. The prologue also introduces Arthur Curry, the half-human, half-Atlantean son of Queen Atlanna (Nicole Kidman) and King Conan (Willem Dafoe).

The story then shifts to the present day, where Arthur is living on land with his mother, who has been keeping his true identity a secret. However, when his half-brother Orm becomes king of Atlantis, he orders the destruction of the surface world in order to save his people.

Arthur's life is turned upside down when he discovers that he is the rightful heir to the throne of Atlantis and that he has the ability to communicate with and control marine life. He also learns that his half-brother Orm is planning to attack the surface world, which would lead to the destruction of both worlds.

As Arthur navigates his new identity as a king, he must confront his own demons and learn to accept his true heritage. Along the way, he meets Mera (Amber Heard), the princess of Xebel, who becomes his ally and love interest.

The plot thickens when Orm orders the destruction of the surface world, which leads Arthur to team up with Mera and a group of allies, including Vulko (Willem Dafoe) and Lobo (Sylvester Stallone), to stop him. Along the way, they encounter various sea creatures, including the giant octopus Black Manta (Yul Vazquez).

As the battle between Arthur and Orm reaches its climax, Arthur must confront his own identity and learn to accept his true power as a king. In the end, he emerges victorious, but not without sacrifices.

The movie ends with Arthur becoming the new king of Atlantis, with Mera by his side. The film concludes on a hopeful note, suggesting that Arthur will work to rebuild and protect both worlds.

Throughout the film, Wan explores themes of identity, power, and responsibility, as well as the consequences of playing with forces beyond one's control. The movie also features impressive action sequences, stunning visual effects, and a talented cast.

Overall, Aquaman is an exciting and visually stunning superhero film that brings a fresh perspective to the DC Extended Universe.

title: Dragons: Dawn Of The Dragon Racers

overview: A hunt for a lost sheep turns into a competition between Hiccup and friends as they compete to become the first Dragon Racing champion of Berk.
plot:
Dawn of the Dragon Racers, also known as Dragons: Dawn of the Dragon Racers, is a 2014 American computer-animated short film produced by DreamWorks Animation and directed by Elaine Bogan and John Sanford. Based on the How to Train Your Dragon franchise, it features the voices of Jay Baruchel as Hiccup and America Ferrera as Astrid, alongside cast members of the television series. Set before How to Train Your Dragon 2, it explains the origin of dragon racing.

As the dragon riders of Berk prepare for the island's official Dragon Race, Snotlout boasts that he invented the sport. Hiccup and Astrid dispute this, and the friends recall how dragon racing began. Years earlier, when the riders were younger, the village was preparing for its traditional annual regatta when a flock of sheep stampeded through the streets, frightened by the voice of Silent Sven. Rounding up the animals turns into an impromptu competition among the young riders and their dragons. Before leaving to gather wood, Chief Stoick puts Hiccup in charge of the regatta preparations.

Hiccup tries to forbid the sheep-catching game, but the others ignore him, and the villagers find it far more exciting than the regatta. Under pressure from the crowd, Hiccup reluctantly allows another race. The riders form two teams: Snotlout and the twins, Ruffnut and Tuffnut, against Hiccup and Astrid. Fishlegs refuses to join, devoted to the regatta. During the race, Astrid injures her arm in a collision with Snotlout while chasing a prized black sheep. Fishlegs finally changes his mind when his boat sinks after his dragon, Meatlug, becomes seasick and spits lava.

Stoick returns and, rather than punishing Hiccup for disobeying, allows the contest to continue, provided it has proper rules: each white sheep is worth one point and the black sheep five, and the winners will have their portrait hung in the Great Hall. The race is tied until the twins appear with a black sheep and claim victory, but Fishlegs then arrives with the real black sheep, revealing that the other team had painted an ordinary sheep. The victory is awarded to Hiccup and Fishlegs, the first dragon racing champions. Back in the present, Hiccup concludes that Tuffnut, who devised the rules, really invented the sport, and the riders rush off to race.

The short was released on November 11, 2014, as a bonus feature on the home media release of How to Train Your Dragon 2, and was later released separately on DVD with earlier franchise shorts.

plot:
Jigsaw is a 2017 American psychological horror film directed by the Spierig Brothers and written by Josh Stolberg and Peter Goldfinger. The movie serves as a sequel to the Saw franchise, ignoring the events of the previous films.

The story begins with Evelyn Johnson (Hannah Emily Anderson), the daughter of John Kramer's (Tobin Bell) former apprentice, who is now an old man living in a nursing home. Evelyn has been searching for her father and his legacy, hoping to understand why he was so obsessed with testing people's will to live.

Evelyn discovers that she is the target of Jigsaw's next game, which is designed to test her own will to survive. She receives a mysterious phone call from Jigsaw, who reveals that he has been watching her and knows about her father's past. Jigsaw claims that Evelyn must prove herself worthy to carry on his legacy by completing three challenges.

The first challenge takes Evelyn to an abandoned warehouse, where she finds a series of puzzles and traps designed to test her physical and mental limits. As she navigates the warehouse, Evelyn is forced to confront her own mortality and the consequences of her father's actions.

As Evelyn progresses through the game, she begins to uncover more about Jigsaw's motivations and the true nature of his tests. She also meets a new character, Logan (Matt Passmore), who becomes her ally in the game.

The second challenge takes Evelyn to a hospital, where she must navigate a series of medical puzzles and confront her own fears and weaknesses. Meanwhile, Logan is revealed to be working for a mysterious organization that seeks to exploit Jigsaw's technology for their own gain.

The final challenge takes Evelyn to an abandoned asylum, where she must face off against a group of ruthless mercenaries who are also seeking to claim Jigsaw's legacy for themselves. In the end, Evelyn emerges victorious, but not without scars and a newfound understanding of her father's complex legacy.

Throughout the movie, the Spierig Brothers explore themes of grief, redemption, and the consequences of playing god. The film features plenty of twists and turns, keeping viewers on the edge of their seats as they try to piece together the puzzle alongside Evelyn.

Overall, Jigsaw is a tense and thought-provoking thriller that expands on the Saw franchise while maintaining its signature style and suspense.

As Tilly navigates her own life and career as a dressmaker, she must confront the painful memories of her past and the complicated bond she shares with her mother.

The film also touches on themes of identity, creativity, and self-discovery. Through Tilly's journey, the movie highlights the importance of embracing one's true self and finding the courage to break free from the constraints of others.

title: All Roads Lead to Rome
tagline: Sometimes first love deserves a second chance...
overview: Maggie is an uptight, single mother and college writing teacher from New York City. In an effort to reconnect with her troubled teen daughter Summer, she decides to embark on a journey to a Tuscan village where she frequented in her younger days. Upon arrival, Maggie runs into Luca a handsome former lover who is still a bachelor and lives with his eighty-year-old mother Carmen. Summer (missing her “bad boy” boyfriend in NYC) and Carmen (secretly planning a wedding against Luca’s wishes to MARCELINO, her one true love in Rome) impulsively steal Luca’s car and race off to Rome. Maggie and Luca quickly pursue allowing the two mismatched couples to spend some time together and develop a new understanding of each other.
plot:
All Roads Lead to Rome is a 2015 romantic comedy directed by Ella Lemhagen and written by Josh Appignanesi and Cindy Myers. Sarah Jessica Parker stars as Maggie Falk, an American journalist revisiting Italy with her rebellious teenage daughter, Summer (Rosie Day), alongside Raoul Bova as her former love, Luca, Claudia Cardinale as Luca's mother, Carmen, Paz Vega as Giulia, a television reporter and Luca's one-time love interest, Nadir Caselli as Luca's daughter, Valentina, and Marco Bonini as Inspector Moravia.

Maggie takes Summer to the Tuscan town where she spent part of her youth. There she runs into Luca, with whom she had a passionate romance decades earlier before she suddenly left for America and cut off all contact. Luca, who still has feelings for her, sets out to win her back. Summer, meanwhile, is desperate to return to the United States and to her selfish boyfriend, Tyler, who wants her to take the blame for a recent drug charge on the grounds that, as a minor, she would receive a lighter sentence. Luca's mother, Carmen, has her own plans: she has been exchanging love letters with Marcellino, her sweetheart from a 1960s pop band, and wants to marry him.

When Carmen and Summer steal Luca's car and race toward Rome, where Carmen and Marcellino have arranged a secret wedding in a church, chaos follows. Summer initially intends to catch a flight home from the Rome airport, but seeing Carmen's devotion makes her realize that Tyler is using her, and she unexpectedly falls for a farm girl, Ermenegilda. Maggie and Luca chase after them, bickering about their shared past along the way, and gradually rekindle their romance as they head for Rome.

Filming began in Rome on October 20, 2014. Marcellino is played by Shel Shapiro, who in real life was a member of the 1960s Italian pop group The Rokes, and Ermenegilda by Rocío Muñoz, the real-life partner of Bova. The film received a limited release in international markets, earning about $524,000, and Momentum Pictures released it on video on demand in North America in March 2016.

title: Cabin Fever
tagline: You can't run from what's inside.
overview: In this grisly remake of the 2002 horror hit, five college chums rent an isolated woodland cabin for a party. But their fun quickly ends when the group is exposed to a hideous flesh-eating virus, and survival becomes the name of the game.
plot:
Cabin Fever (2016) is a horror-comedy film that explores several themes, including social isolation, paranoia, and the breakdown of human relationships under pressure.

The movie takes place in a remote cabin where a group of friends, all with different personalities and quirks, are brought together by their mutual desire for a relaxing getaway. However, as the story unfolds, it becomes clear that each character has their own secrets and insecurities, which slowly start to surface, leading to a descent into chaos.

As the characters' behavior becomes increasingly erratic and paranoid, the film highlights the dangers of unchecked emotions and the devastating consequences of allowing personal demons to consume one's relationships. The movie also touches on the theme of social hierarchy, as the characters' initial camaraderie gives way to a struggle for dominance and power.

Throughout the film, the tension builds as the characters' behavior becomes more erratic, leading to a climax that is both shocking and thought-provoking. Ultimately, Cabin Fever (2016) is a commentary on how quickly social norms can break down in the face of adversity, revealing the darker aspects of human nature.

The film's tone is often described as darkly comedic, with a touch of satire, which adds to its unique charm and makes it a standout in the horror-comedy genre.

title: The Gallows
tagline: Every School Has Its Spirit.
overview: 20 years after a horrific accident during a small town school play, students at the school resurrect the failed show in a misguided attempt to honor the anniversary of the tragedy - but soon discover that some things are better left alone.
plot:
The Gallows is a 2015 American supernatural horror film in the found-footage style, written and directed by Chris Lofing and Travis Cluff. Reese Mishler, Pfeifer Brown, Ryan Shoos and Cassidy Gifford play high school students who revive a play twenty years after a fatal accident during its first staging. Jason Blum produced the film through Blumhouse Productions.

On October 29, 1993, Charlie Grimille, a student at Beatrice High School, is accidentally hanged when a prop fails during a performance of the play The Gallows, in front of his parents and the whole audience. Twenty years later, the school decides to stage the play again. Reese Houser, a football player, auditions only to get closer to Pfeifer Ross, on whom he has a crush, and unexpectedly lands the lead. Wanting out, he goes along with his friend Ryan's plan to wreck the set, and that night Reese, Ryan and Ryan's girlfriend Cassidy break into the school. Interrupted by Pfeifer, the four discover that they are locked in and have no phone signal. Cassidy confesses why they are there, angering Pfeifer.

Back on stage, they find the set has rebuilt itself, and an old television plays news footage of Charlie's death, including an interview with his girlfriend Alexis. They learn that Charlie had only gone on as an understudy, replacing the lead actor, Reese's father Rick. The group splits up, and Ryan stumbles on a hidden room and a hanging body. Cassidy is hoisted into the air by an invisible force and left with marks like rope burns. Trying to escape through an air duct, Ryan is thrown from a ladder and breaks his leg, and when the others return they find only his phone, whose footage shows him being dragged away by the neck. Cassidy is then killed by Charlie, dressed as the Hangman from the play. On the stage, the spirit begins to strangle Pfeifer, and Reese realises that Charlie wants them to perform the final scene. When Reese puts the noose around his neck, Charlie hangs him. Pfeifer and an adult Charlie take a bow as Alexis applauds. Police later visit the home of Pfeifer and Alexis, revealing that Pfeifer is Charlie and Alexis's daughter; when the officers mention Charlie's name, they are killed.

Lofing and Cluff's trailer went viral in 2011, attracting the producers who brought the project to Blumhouse. Made for just $100,000, it grossed $43 million worldwide, but critics panned it, with 15% on Rotten Tomatoes and a C CinemaScore.

title: Drumline: A New Beat
tagline: #PassTheBaton
overview: A girl from New York attends a college in Atlanta to join their once-famous marching band.
plot:
Drumline: A New Beat is a 2014 American musical drama television film directed by Bille Woodruff from a screenplay by Karen Gist and Regina Hicks. A sequel to the 2002 film Drumline, it returns to the fictional Atlanta A&T University and its marching band, telling a largely new story about a fresh generation of drummers at the historically black college. Alexandra Shipp stars as Danielle "Dani" Raymond, with Jordan Calloway as Jayven LaPierre, Jeff Pierre as her cousin Tyree, Mario Van Peebles and Lisa Arrindell as her parents, LeToya Luckett as Dr. Nia Phillips, DeRay Davis, Jasmine Burke, Rome Flynn and Tye White. Leonard Roberts reprises his role as Sean Taylor, and Nick Cannon, who also executive produced, returns as Devon Miles.

Twelve years after the first film, Dani, a drummer from a wealthy Brooklyn family, defies her parents, who want her to attend Spelman, and heads to Atlanta A&T on a partial scholarship, determined to help revive the Panthers' once-celebrated drumline and to become the first woman to lead its section. Her cousin Tyree is a senior on the line, but the new band director, Sean Taylor, gives her no special treatment. As a freshman she endures hazing from upperclassmen, a rule against romance within the band, and open resistance from a drummer who says no woman belongs on the line, while she falls in with a group of misfits and is drawn to Jayven, a charming bandmate and rival with a troubled past whose father is a well-known singer.

The Panthers' long rivalry with Southern State provides the competition, with drumline face-offs staged at football games. Dissension within the band and challenges for places on the line drive Dani and Jayven apart, and at one point she moves to transfer away from the school before returning. Devon Miles, now a music star, arrives to show the young drummers that he still has the touch, and at the Big Southern Classic A&T wins for the first time in six years, then triumphs again in a final drumline battle as Dani and Jayven reconcile.

Filmed in Atlanta in May 2014, the film premiered on VH1 on 27 October 2014 and was released on DVD in March 2015. Reviews were largely unfavorable: Blavity's Shadow and Act called it overlong and overstuffed, with hammy acting and too little drumming, while other viewers enjoyed it as a predictable but nostalgic return to the world of the original.

title: Avengers: Endgame
tagline: Avenge the fallen.
overview: After the devastating events of Avengers: Infinity War, the universe is in ruins due to the efforts of the Mad Titan, Thanos.
