overview: A group of survivors from all walks of the apocalypse – an idiotic Sheriff with definite coma-induced brain damage, his hardass son and a hobo with only a crossbow to stave off the walking dead, four squabbling friends forced to survive this zombieland together, and a lonely zombie who just needs love to fully regain his warm body – leave their once-safe mall hideout in search of the rumored Safe Haven Ranch, a refuge untouched by the zombie virus that has ravaged humanity.
plot:
The Walking Deceased, originally titled Walking with the Dead, is a 2015 American comedy horror film directed by Scott Dow and written by Tim Ogletree. Conceived as a zombie spoof that would be the first to lampoon The Walking Dead, it also pokes fun at other genre favourites such as Shaun of the Dead, and stars Ogletree, Joey Oglesby, Dave Sheridan, Troy Ogletree, Sophie Taylor Ali, Danielle Garcia, Andrew Pozza and Mason Dakota Galyon as a band of survivors searching for a safe haven.

The outbreak begins when a sushi chef fails to wash his hands before serving a meal to homeless dumpster-divers. Twenty-nine days later, a zombie named Romeo muses that the undead are gradually regaining their humanity. In a hospital, the survivors Chicago and Green Bay encounter the dim-witted Sheriff Lincoln, freshly awake from a coma, who sets out to find his family. He discovers that his son Chris has taken shelter at his wife's workplace, a strip club, which the boy has been running. After Lincoln's wife is bitten, father and son head for the mall, where they join the other survivors, including Brooklyn, her sister Harlem and the rumour-spreading Darnell. Romeo, smitten with Brooklyn, follows her and saves her from an attack, and she finds herself drawn to him.

Under the bickering joint leadership of Lincoln and Chicago, the group sets out for "the farm", a rumoured zombie-free refuge owned by an elderly couple, the Reganites, whose daughter Isaac is suspected of being undead. She proves uninfected; her half-senile parents simply have no idea the outbreak has happened. A drug-fuelled night of fireworks draws a horde of zombies, Darnell is killed after accidentally shooting a lone super-survivor, and Harlem reveals she is deaf and has been lip-reading all along. Brooklyn lets Romeo bite her so they can be together, only to learn that a cure has been added to the water supply, and the survivors turn hoses and water guns on the undead. The celebratory party that follows is cut short by news of a Texas-sized meteor heading for Earth.

The film premiered at WalkerStalkerCon on March 15, 2015, and was released theatrically by ARC Entertainment five days later. It was panned: Rotten Tomatoes recorded no positive reviews among 11 critics, Metacritic gave it 9 out of 100, and The Hollywood Reporter dismissed it as a lame, outdated satire.

title: E N V O Y
overview: A young boy discovers a deadly alien creature and winds up entangled in a top secret government operation.
plot:
E N V O Y (usually written Envoy) is a 2014 American science fiction short film written, directed and produced by David Weinstein. Made by Valkyrie Pictures and Black Sun Entertainment and running nine minutes, it was released online in September 2014 as a self-funded "proof of concept" intended to introduce a story that Weinstein hoped to develop into a feature and to show that high-end visual effects could be produced for a fraction of the usual cost. Weinstein, whose earlier design work includes the Star Wars prequels and the Matrix sequels, made it with his long-time collaborator Adam Coggin, who supervised the effects, following their earlier animated short Azureus Rising.

The story unfolds among cornfields. Young Kyle brings his older brother, Jason, out to the cornfields to show him something strange that has been happening for a week: whenever he throws a basketball into the corn, it is thrown back. Jason is astonished when the ball returns, and even more so by what steps out of the field, a deadly alien creature built like a sleek war machine, which the filmmakers call Aeon. The two brothers soon find themselves entangled in a top-secret government operation as the military moves in, and the creature, despite its menace, shows mercy toward innocent life and protects its young human playmates when the soldiers launch an all-out assault.

Weinstein described the short as a love letter to the action-adventure and science fiction films of the 1980s and 1990s. The production was completed in under a year of part-time work on a post-production budget of only a few thousand dollars, which meant building a live-action CGI pipeline and render farm to create computer-generated Apache helicopters, birds, corn, the basketball and the alien itself. The film became a viral success, drawing more than ten million combined views and appearing on major short film websites.

Critics agreed that its effects were its main attraction. Short of the Week saw the influence of Steven Spielberg, J. J. Abrams's Super 8 and Iron Man, noting the coming-of-age thread but saying it would win no prizes for originality while catching the eye of talent scouts. Singularity Hub praised the alien's design but found the story recycled and the military response clichéd. Cinema Crazed was more enthusiastic, calling it The Iron Giant meets Predator and arguing that it deserved a big-budget feature treatment.

title: Animal Crackers
tagline: A magical adventure in every bite
overview: A family must use a magical box of Animal Crackers to save a rundown circus from being taken over by their evil uncle Horatio P. Huntington.
plot:
Animal Crackers is a 2017 animated fantasy comedy directed by Scott Christian Sava and Tony Bancroft, written by Sava and Dean Lorey, and inspired by the animal-shaped cookies and by Sava's graphic novel. Its voice cast includes John Krasinski and Emily Blunt as Owen and Zoe Huntington, Ian McKellen, Danny DeVito, Sylvester Stallone, Patrick Warburton, Raven-Symoné as Binkley, Harvey Fierstein as the fortune-teller Esmeralda, Gilbert Gottfried as Mario Zucchini, Tara Strong as Talia, James Arnold Taylor as Buffalo Bob and Kevin Grevioux as Samson the Strong Man.

In the 1960s, brothers Buffalo Bob and Horatio Huntington run a successful traveling circus, until both fall for Talia, niece of the circus fortune-teller Esmeralda. When Talia chooses Bob, the jealous Horatio breaks with his brother. As a wedding gift, Esmeralda gives the couple a mysterious box, which allows them to open a new circus famous for animals that perform seemingly impossible feats. Years later, Bob's nephew Owen marries his childhood sweetheart Zoe at the circus, but to please her father, Mr. Woodley, he takes a dull job as a taste tester at Woodley's dog biscuit factory.

After Horatio, whose fortunes have collapsed, accidentally causes a fire that seemingly kills Bob and Talia, Owen and Zoe inherit the circus, and Horatio tries to take it from them. The circus pets give the family the mysterious box, which turns out to contain magical animal crackers: whoever eats one turns into the animal it depicts, while a single human-shaped cracker changes them back. Owen discovers that this was the secret of the circus's success, with performers taking turns as animals. Embracing his new life, he must save the circus from Horatio and his henchmen, keep his family together and recover the precious human cracker that will return him to human form.

The film celebrates family, imagination and following one's dreams, set against the colorful backdrop of a traditional circus.

Animal Crackers premiered at the Annecy International Animation Film Festival in 2017 and was released in China in 2018, before reaching Netflix in July 2020. It received mixed-to-positive reviews, with 67 percent approval on Rotten Tomatoes and a Metacritic score of 60.

title: The Boy and the Beast
tagline: In a world of beasts, he found a family.
overview: Kyuta, a boy living in Shibuya, and Kumatetsu, a lonesome beast from Jutengai, an imaginary world. One day, Kyuta forays into the imaginary world and, as he's looking for his way back, meets Kumatetsu who becomes his spirit guide. That encounter leads them to many adventures.
plot:
The Boy and the Beast (Bakemono no Ko) is a Japanese animated fantasy adventure of 2015 written and directed by Mamoru Hosoda. Kōji Yakusho voices the beast warrior Kumatetsu, with Shōta Sometani and Aoi Miyazaki as the older and younger Kyūta, Suzu Hirose as Kaede, Mamoru Miyano as Ichirōhiko and Lily Franky as Hyakushūbō.

Nine-year-old Ren has just lost his mother. With no word from his father and refusing to live with his relatives, he runs away into the streets of Shibuya. In the hidden Beast Kingdom, the Grandmaster announces that he will retire to be reborn as a god and names two possible successors: the popular Iōzen, a father of two, and the mighty but lonely and lazy Kumatetsu, whom he urges to take a disciple. Wandering Tokyo with his companion Tatara, Kumatetsu meets Ren and offers to train him. Ren refuses but follows him out of curiosity into the Beast Kingdom and cannot find his way back. Kumatetsu takes him as an apprentice and names him Kyūta. Their early lessons are disastrous, but Kyūta learns by copying his master's movements as he does the chores, soon anticipating his every move.

Eight years later, Kyūta has become a skilled fighter, and their bond has won Kumatetsu followers of his own, including Iōzen's younger son Jirōmaru. Kyūta finds a way back to the human world, where he befriends a student, Kaede, and is reunited with his father. Torn between his two lives, he rejects both his father and Kumatetsu and feels a dark void opening within him, until Kaede calms him and gives him a bracelet. At the succession duel, Kumatetsu falters until Kyūta appears and cheers him to victory. But Iōzen's elder son Ichirōhiko, secretly a human foundling raised as a beast, is consumed by the same darkness; he gravely wounds Kumatetsu and vanishes. Kyūta pursues him, and Ichirōhiko attacks him and Kaede in Tokyo in the form of a monstrous whale. Kyūta prepares to sacrifice himself by absorbing Ichirōhiko's darkness, but Kumatetsu uses his new right as lord to be reborn as a god in the form of a sword, which fills the emptiness in Kyūta's heart. Together they defeat Ichirōhiko without killing him, and he wakes among his adoptive family. Reconciled with his father, Ren chooses to live in the human world, with Kumatetsu forever in his heart.

Released in July 2015, the film topped the Japanese box office, grossed 5.85 billion yen and won Animation of the Year at the Japan Academy Prizes. It scored 88% on Rotten Tomatoes.

title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
tagline: Homework can wait. The city can't.
overview: Following the events of Captain America: Civil War, Peter Parker, with the help of his mentor Tony Stark, tries to balance his life as an ordinary high school student in Queens, New York City, with fighting crime as his superhero alter ego Spider-Man as a new threat, the Vulture, emerges.
plot:
Spider-Man: Homecoming is a 2017 superhero film directed by Jon Watts, produced by Kevin Feige, and based on the Marvel Comics character of the same name. The movie follows the story of Peter Parker (played by Tom Holland), a high school student who has been living with his Aunt May (Marisa Tomei) in Queens, New York.

Peter is still trying to balance his life as a teenager with his responsibilities as Spider-Man, a superhero who has been fighting crime and protecting the city from various villains. However, he feels that he needs more guidance and mentorship from someone experienced in the field of superheroism.

Enter Tony Stark/Iron Man (Robert Downey Jr.), who is impressed by Peter's skills and decides to take him under his wing as a protégé. Tony becomes Peter's mentor, teaching him how to be a better Spider-Man and helping him navigate the complexities of being a superhero.

However, a new villain emerges in the form of the Vulture (Michael Keaton), a former Air Force pilot who has become obsessed with technology and wealth. The Vulture is determined to steal valuable technology from various sources, including a high-tech company called Oscorp, which is owned by Norman Osborn (Michael Chernus).

As Peter tries to stop the Vulture, he also faces challenges from his peers at school, particularly his friend Ned Leeds (Jacob Batalon), who becomes increasingly jealous of Peter's newfound fame as Spider-Man. Meanwhile, Peter's relationship with his Aunt May is put to the test when she discovers that he has been using his powers to fight crime.

Throughout the movie, Peter learns valuable lessons about responsibility, humility, and the importance of teamwork. He also comes to terms with his own identity and the weight of being a superhero. The film features plenty of action-packed sequences, witty banter, and heartfelt moments, making it a delightful addition to the Marvel Cinematic Universe.

Overall, Spider-Man: Homecoming is a fun and engaging movie that explores themes of identity, responsibility, and friendship. With its talented cast, clever script, and impressive visuals, it's a must-see for fans of superhero movies and anyone looking for a light-hearted, entertaining film experience.

title: Florence Foster Jenkins
tagline: People may say I couldn't sing, but no one can say I didn't sing
overview: The story of Florence Foster Jenkins, a New York heiress, who dreamed of becoming an opera singer, despite having a terrible singing voice.
plot:
Florence Foster Jenkins is a 2016 biographical comedy-drama directed by Stephen Frears and written by Nicholas Martin and Julia Kogan. Meryl Streep stars as the title character, a New York heiress remembered for her generosity and her famously bad singing, and Hugh Grant plays her manager and long-time companion, St. Clair Bayfield. Filming began in May 2015, and the film opened in the United Kingdom on 6 May 2016 and, through Paramount Pictures, in the United States that August.

In 1944, Florence is a wealthy New York socialite who founded the Verdi Club out of her love of music. Bayfield, a British Shakespearean actor, devotes himself to her career while living separately with his mistress, Kathleen, and Florence has long suffered from the syphilis she contracted from her first husband. Inspired by a Lily Pons concert, she resumes singing lessons and hires the pianist Cosmé McMoon, who is appalled by her voice while Bayfield and her vocal coach pretend she is wonderful. Bayfield arranges a small recital for hand-picked guests, and Florence records a disc for the club's members as a Christmas present. McMoon learns that she had once been a gifted pianist, and the two grow close as they write and perform songs together. When one recording reaches the radio, many listeners find it hilarious.

Florence then books Carnegie Hall and gives away a thousand tickets to soldiers. Bayfield cannot talk her out of it, gets into a fight with men mocking her in a bar and loses Kathleen, and persuades the reluctant McMoon to stand by her even at the risk of his career. Before a packed house that includes Cole Porter and Tallulah Bankhead, the soldiers jeer at first, but her friends shout them down and she finishes the concert. Bayfield and McMoon buy up local copies of the New York Post to hide Earl Wilson's scathing review, but Florence finds one in a trash can and collapses. On her deathbed she imagines herself singing beautifully, and tells Bayfield that people may say she could not sing, but no one can say she did not sing.

Simon Helberg plays McMoon, with Rebecca Ferguson and Nina Arianda, who plays the showgirl Agnes Stark. Critics were enthusiastic, giving it 87% approval on Rotten Tomatoes and praising Streep in particular, and it grossed about $56 million worldwide. Streep received her 20th Academy Award nomination, for Best Actress, and the film was also nominated for Best Costume Design and four Golden Globes.

title: Ghost in the Shell
tagline: There's nothing sadder than a puppet without a ghost.
overview: In the near future, Major is the first of her kind: a human saved from a terrible crash, then cyber-enhanced to be a perfect soldier devoted to stopping the world's most dangerous criminals.
plot:
Ghost in the Shell is a 2017 cyberpunk action thriller directed by Rupert Sanders and written by Jamie Moss, William Wheeler and Ehren Kruger, the first live-action adaptation of Masamune Shirow's Japanese manga franchise. Scarlett Johansson stars as Major Mira Killian, with Takeshi Kitano, Michael Pitt, Pilou Asbæk, Chin Han and Juliette Binoche in supporting roles.

In a near future where people routinely enhance their bodies with cybernetics, the corporation Hanka Robotics secretly develops a synthetic body, or shell, that can house a human brain instead of an artificial intelligence. Killian, told she is the lone survivor of a cyberterrorist attack that killed her parents, becomes its first successful subject, and Hanka's chief executive, Cutter, overrides her designer Dr. Ouelet to turn her into a weapon. A year later she is a Major in the anti-terrorism unit Section 9, serving with Batou and Togusa under Chief Daisuke Aramaki, though she is troubled by hallucinations and a past she cannot recall.

After the team foils an attack on a Hanka conference, Killian learns that a hacker called Kuze is murdering the company's senior scientists. Tracking him, the team is lured into a trap at a yakuza nightclub, and an explosion destroys Batou's eyes. When Killian is captured, Kuze reveals that he is an earlier, failed subject of the same programme and tells her that her medication suppresses her real memories. Ouelet admits that 98 subjects died before Killian and that her past was fabricated; ordered by Cutter to kill her, she instead helps her escape, and Cutter murders Ouelet and brands Killian a rogue. An address leads Killian to a widowed woman whose daughter, Motoko Kusanagi, ran away and supposedly took her own life in custody. Killian finds Kuze at their old hideout, where they recall being anti-augmentation radicals abducted by Hanka. Killian destroys a spider-tank Cutter sends after them, losing an arm, but a sniper kills Kuze. Aramaki executes Cutter, and Killian, embracing her identity as Motoko, reconnects with her mother and returns to Section 9.

Shot mainly in New Zealand in 2016, the film grossed $169.8 million worldwide against a $110 million budget. Reviews were mixed, with 43% on Rotten Tomatoes, praising the visuals and Johansson's performance but faulting the story, and her casting drew accusations of whitewashing.

title: Correspondence
tagline: Forbidden love. Undying devotion.
overview: The relationship between Ed, a married astronomer and Amy, his lover, who spend their years apart, is based only on phone calls and texts. One day Amy begins noticing something strange in Ed's messages.
plot:
Correspondence (La corrispondenza), also released as The Correspondence, is a 2016 English-language Italian romantic drama written and directed by Giuseppe Tornatore. It stars Jeremy Irons and Olga Kurylenko, and Ennio Morricone composed the score.

Ed Phoerum, an astrophysics professor, and Amy Ryan, a doctoral student, have been secret lovers for six years. They see each other only when his conferences allow and otherwise stay in touch through video calls, emails and packages. Amy pays for her studies with stunt work and seems drawn to scenes in which her character dies. When Ed's messages keep arriving but he stops answering his phone, she goes to one of his lectures and learns that he died in Edinburgh days earlier. Bewildered by the emails still coming in his name, she travels to Scotland. His lawyer gives her a video in which Ed explains that he hid his terminal illness from her.

Before he died, Ed arranged a long chain of letters, videos and gifts timed to reach her for months. He directed her to his summer house on an island in an Italian lake. On the last night there, a video shows he knows her darkest secret: the car accident that killed her father, which she blames on herself. Furious, Amy burns the disc and sends the code that stops the messages, then regrets it. Her attempts to recover the lost material lead her to Ed's daughter and his lawyer. She learns that friends and colleagues have been passing on his instructions, and the ferryman Ottavio gives her memory cards showing Ed filming himself as a brain tumor took hold. After finding pencil impressions in his notebook, Amy realizes she used the wrong code. Once the messages resume, they push her to reconcile with her mother, finish her thesis and confront her trauma by performing a car stunt like her father's fatal accident. She inherits the island house and receives Ed's final farewell. At a sculpture exhibition, she sees herself in an artwork that captured her grief. Outside, she meets a younger colleague whom Ed's messages seemed to foresee, and leaves open the chance of a new beginning.

Paco Cinematografica and Rai Cinema produced the film, which was shot over ten weeks in Italy, York and Edinburgh. Much of the crew from Tornatore's The Best Offer returned. The film was released in Italy on January 14, 2016, and grossed about $3.8 million.

title: Mike and Dave Need Wedding Dates

tagline: They needed hot dates. They got hot messes.
overview: Mike and Dave are young, adventurous, fun-loving brothers who tend to get out of control at family gatherings. When their sister Jeanie reveals her Hawaiian wedding plans, the rest of the Stangles insist that the brothers bring respectable dates. After placing an ad on Craigslist, the siblings decide to pick Tatiana and Alice, two charming and seemingly normal women. Once they arrive on the island, however, Mike and Dave realize that their companions are ready to get wild and party.
plot:
Mike and Dave Need Wedding Dates is a 2016 American comedy film directed by Jake Kasdan and written by Dan Mazer, Sean Anders, and John Morris. The movie stars Zac Efron, Adam DeVine, Anna Kendrick, and Stephen Root.

The story begins with two middle-aged men, Stu (Adam DeVine) and Dave (Zac Efron), who are best friends since childhood. They live in a small town in Colorado and work at a local brewery. The movie takes place on the day of their friend's wedding, where they are supposed to be the best man and groomsmen.

However, things take a turn when Stu and Dave realize that they have no idea who will attend their friend's wedding or how they will get there. They decide to put up posters around town asking for people to come to the wedding as "fake" dates, hoping to find someone willing to pretend to be their girlfriend.

To their surprise, two women respond to the ads: Janet (Anna Kendrick), a high-strung and uptight woman from New York City, and Tatiana (Aubrey Plaza), a free-spirited and eccentric woman who is also looking for a fake date. Stu and Dave are hesitant at first, but eventually agree to take both women on as their fake girlfriends.

As the wedding day approaches, Stu and Dave try to navigate their relationships with Janet and Tatiana, while also dealing with their own personal issues and insecurities. Meanwhile, Janet and Tatiana start to develop real feelings for each other, which complicates things further.

On the night of the wedding, Stu and Dave's fake girlfriends are supposed to meet them at the reception, but they fail to show up. Panicked, Stu and Dave decide to take their fake girlfriends on a road trip to the wedding, hoping that they will eventually reveal their true intentions.

As the movie progresses, Stu and Dave learn valuable lessons about friendship, love, and being true to oneself. They also discover that Janet and Tatiana are not just fake girlfriends, but two women who have been searching for connection and meaning in their lives.

In the end, the wedding reception is a disaster, with Stu and Dave's fake girlfriends failing to show up. However, instead of being disappointed, Stu and Dave realize that they have found something special in each other and in Janet and Tatiana. The movie ends on a hopeful note, with the four main characters embarking on new adventures together.

Overall, Mike and Dave Need Wedding Dates is a heartwarming and hilarious comedy that explores themes of friendship, love, and self-discovery. With its talented cast and witty dialogue, it's a must-see for fans of romantic comedies.

title: The Greatest Showman
tagline: The impossible comes true.
overview: The story of American showman P.T. Barnum, founder of the circus that became the famous traveling Ringling Bros. and Barnum & Bailey Circus.
plot:
The Greatest Showman is a musical drama film released in 2017, directed by Michael Gracey and produced by 20th Century Fox. The movie is inspired by the life of P.T. Barnum, a showman and businessman who founded the Barnum & Bailey Circus.

The film begins with P.T. Barnum (played by Hugh Jackman) as a poor tailor living in Hartford, Connecticut. He dreams of becoming a showman and creating a spectacle that will amaze people. After being rejected multiple times, Barnum finally gets his chance when he meets Philip Carlyle (played by Zac Efron), a young playwright who is looking for inspiration.

Barnum and Carlyle form an unlikely partnership, with Barnum using Carlyle's writing skills to create a show that will attract audiences. They recruit a group of outcasts and misfits, including Jenny Lind (played by Rebecca Ferguson), a Swedish soprano; Tom Thumb (played by Sam Humphrey), a dwarf; and Lettie Lutz (played by Keala Settle), a bearded lady.

As the show gains popularity, Barnum becomes more confident in his abilities and starts to take risks. He recruits more performers and creates a spectacle that is unlike anything seen before. However, his success also attracts the attention of Philip Carlyle's father, Charles Carlyle (played by Jake Gyllenhaal), who disapproves of Barnum's methods.

Despite the opposition, Barnum continues to push forward, using his charisma and showmanship skills to win over audiences. He also falls in love with Charity Hallett (played by Zendaya), a trapeze artist who becomes one of his performers.

As the years pass, Barnum's circus becomes a sensation, attracting people from all over the world. However, he faces numerous challenges, including financial struggles and personal conflicts. In the end, Barnum must confront his own demons and learn to let go of his ego in order to create something truly special.

The film ends with P.T. Barnum's circus being a huge success, attracting millions of people worldwide. The final scene shows Barnum standing on stage, surrounded by his performers, as he looks out at the audience with pride and gratitude. The movie ends on a hopeful note, suggesting that even the most unlikely person can achieve greatness with hard work and determination.

Throughout the film, the music plays a significant role in bringing the story to life. The soundtrack features original songs written by Benj Pasek and Justin Paul, including "This Is Me," "The Greatest Show," and "A Million Dreams." The music is catchy and upbeat, perfectly capturing the spirit of the circus and its performers.

Overall, The Greatest Showman is a heartwarming and inspiring film that celebrates the power of creativity and perseverance. With its stunning visuals, memorable characters, and catchy music, it's no wonder why this movie became a global phenomenon.

title: Free State of Jones
tagline: For justice. For pride. For freedom.

title: The Bad Batch
tagline: Don’t play with your food.
overview: Arlen is sent to a fenced-off wasteland where undesirables are exiled to when she is kidnapped by a group of cannibals. She escapes and ends up on a journey to reunite a missing girl with her father.
plot:
A young woman named Arlen is exiled to a desert outside Texas, where people deemed undesirable by the government (the "bad batch") are forced to fend for themselves. A sign declares the area outside of the US and that American laws and citizenship no longer apply. Arlen is soon kidnapped by two women in a golf cart. When she wakes chained up, a woman cuts off her right arm and leg. Arlen tricks the woman into unchaining her, kills her, observes cannibalism of human limbs, and escapes crawling on a skateboard. She is rescued in the desert by a mute hermit, who takes her to a makeshift settlement named Comfort that has all-night raves.
Five months later, Arlen has a prosthetic leg and a home in Comfort. She walks out to the desert with a pistol. Investigating a golf cart similar to the one used by the cannibals, she finds a woman and little girl scavenging in a garbage dump. Accusing the woman of being part of the cannibal community, Arlen shoots her in the head. She is observed by the hermit as she takes the girl, Honey, back to Comfort. Miami Man, a leader of the cannibals and the father of Honey, goes looking for her, finding the dead woman, and then the hermit. The hermit, in exchange for a hand-sketched portrait, advises Miami Man to "find Comfort".
In Comfort, Arlen takes a hallucinogen at a rave held by The Dream, the cult-like leader of Comfort, and loses track of the child, who is taken in by The Dream. Hallucinating, Arlen wanders out into the desert, where Miami Man finds her. Upon threat of death, he demands that she find his daughter in Comfort.
Arlen and Miami Man grow closer on their journey to Comfort. He kills another cannibal who is looking to trade gasoline for her flesh and reveals that he was put into the lawless territory because he was an illegal immigrant from Cuba. However, another man shoots Miami Man in the chest, and Arlen somewhat reluctantly returns to Comfort. She searches for Honey, eventually discovering she is living in The Dream's mansion, along with his large harem of pregnant young women.
Arlen visits The Dream, who explains that Comfort's economy is run on the drugs his concubines make, and that Comfort is free of feces because of the plumbing he provides. Arlen agrees to join his harem but uses a pistol she has hidden inside her prosthetic to hold one of the pregnant concubines hostage. After extracting the girl, they head out of Comfort in a golf cart and reunite with Miami Man, who had been found and healed by the hermit.
The child and Miami Man blissfully reunite, and Arlen implies she would rather stay with him in the desert than live in Comfort. Miami Man tries to discourage her, deeming her unable to survive out in the harsh desert, but does not send her away. Honey asks for spaghetti, as she had grown accustomed to good things in the mansion. Instead, Miami Man takes his daughter's pet rabbit, and later the three of them lounge by a fire eating it.

title: Barbie in Princess Power
tagline: Take flight with a new kind of princess!
overview: Barbie is Kara - a modern-day princess with a normal life. Kissed by a butterfly which gives her superpowers and allows her to become a Super Sparkle, she is ready to save the kingdom from evil - were it not for her jealous cousin who is also kissed by the butterfly and becomes her rival and nemesis. Watch as Super Sparkle and Dark Sparkle learn that together they can become a great team for good once they learn the power of friendship.
plot:
Barbie in Princess Power is a 2015 computer-animated fantasy adventure film produced by Mattel Playground Productions as part of the long-running series of direct-to-video Barbie films. Directed by Ezekiel "Zeke" Norton from a script by Marsha Griffin, it features music by Jim Dooley. Kelly Sheridan voices Barbie as Princess Kara, with Britt Irvin as her cousin Corinne, Michael Kopsa as Baron von Ravendale, Rebecca Husain and Kira Tozer as Kara's friends Madison and Makalya, and Patricia Drake and Michael Adamthwaite as Queen Karina and King Kristoff. The supporting voice cast includes David Kaye, Chelsea Miller, Gabe Khouth and Tabitha St. Germain.

Kara is a modern princess of the kingdom of Windermere with a fairly ordinary life and ambitious goals, such as starting a community garden, who would rather fly aircraft than attend formal balls. Her loving parents, however, are so overprotective that they refuse to let her take any risks, which is especially frustrating because her best friends Madison and Makalya are scientific prodigies whose inventions constantly tempt her toward adventure. Unknown to the royal family, Baron von Ravendale, one of the king's trusted advisers, is brewing a potion as part of a scheme to destroy the king and seize the throne for himself.

When the potion escapes his control, a butterfly that swallows it becomes a magical creature, and its kiss gives Kara superpowers, including strength, agility and the ability to fly. With her friends' help she becomes the superheroine Super Sparkle, secretly rescuing citizens from fires, collapsing construction sites and robbers. Her jealous cousin Corinne discovers her secret, captures the butterfly and uses its power to transform herself into Dark Sparkle, and the two compete to be the town's top hero. When the Baron drinks a potion that grants him magical powers and unleashes lava from a volcano on the castle and the town, the rivals must set aside their competition and fight him together to save their families and the kingdom.

Released on DVD and digital platforms by Universal in early 2015, the film added a superhero dimension to the Barbie brand and introduced a new line of dolls. Common Sense Media found it a fun adventure with more action and peril than earlier Barbie films, praising the heroine's resourcefulness and her scientifically gifted friends, while the Australian Council on Children and the Media highlighted its message that working together is better than being alone.

Detective Conan: Sunflowers of Inferno is a thrilling mystery film that delves into the darker aspects of human nature and the blurred lines between good and evil. The story revolves around the mysterious Sunflower Organization, a group of individuals who are seemingly ordinary but possess extraordinary abilities.

At its core, the movie explores the theme of deception and manipulation, as the protagonist, Shinichi Kudo, navigates through a complex web of lies and half-truths to uncover the truth behind the Sunflower Organization. The film masterfully weaves together elements of psychological suspense, action, and mystery, keeping the audience on the edge of their seats.

One of the primary themes that emerges in Detective Conan: Sunflowers of Inferno is the concept of identity and how it can be manipulated and distorted. The characters within the Sunflower Organization are expertly crafted to be charismatic and believable, making it difficult for Shinichi to distinguish between friend and foe. This theme is further underscored by the film's exploration of the blurred lines between reality and fantasy.

The movie also touches on the idea of obsession and the dangers of becoming too entrenched in one's own desires. The Sunflower Organization's leader, a character known as "Sunflower," is driven by an all-consuming passion that ultimately leads to their downfall. This theme serves as a cautionary tale about the perils of allowing oneself to become consumed by one's own ambitions.

Throughout the film, TMS Entertainment expertly crafts a sense of tension and unease, creating an atmosphere that is both captivating and unsettling. The result is a movie that is both entertaining and thought-provoking, leaving viewers with a lasting impression long after the credits roll.

plot:
The Last: Naruto the Movie is a 2014 Japanese animated film directed by Tensai Okamura, produced by Studio Pierrot and Aniplex. The movie takes place after the events of the Naruto Shippuden series.

The story revolves around Naruto Uzumaki, now in his mid-20s, who has become the Seventh Hokage of Konoha. However, a mysterious threat emerges in the form of Kaguya Otsutsuki, the true enemy that Naruto and Sasuke had been searching for throughout their lives.

Kaguya is revealed to be the origin of chakra, the source of all ninja power, and she seeks to reclaim her lost powers by gathering the nine tailed beasts. She plans to use these beasts' combined strength to destroy the world and rule over it.

Naruto, along with his friends Sakura Haruno and Sasuke Uchiha, must now face their greatest challenge yet as they try to stop Kaguya's plan. Along the way, Naruto is forced to confront his own doubts and fears about being a leader and his ability to protect his village.

The movie features epic battles, emotional character development, and explores themes of friendship, sacrifice, and the true meaning of leadership. The animation is stunning, with vibrant colors and detailed action sequences that bring the world of Naruto to life.

Throughout the film, Naruto's growth as a character is on full display as he grapples with his responsibilities as Hokage and his own sense of identity. His relationships with Sakura and Sasuke are also put to the test as they face their own personal struggles and doubts.

Overall, The Last: Naruto the Movie is an epic conclusion to the Naruto series that will leave fans emotionally invested in the characters and their journey. It's a must-watch for anyone who loves the Naruto franchise or is looking for an exciting adventure with memorable characters and stunning animation.

title: Careful What You Wish For
tagline: Wanting her was his first mistake
overview: A guy gets more than he bargained for after entering into an affair with the wife of an investment banker. Soon, a suspicious death and substantial life insurance policy embroil him in a scandal.
plot:
Careful What You Wish For is a 2015 American erotic thriller directed by Elizabeth Allen Rosenbaum. It stars Nick Jonas as Doug Martin, Isabel Lucas as Lena Harper and Dermot Mulroney as her husband Elliot, with Graham Rogers, Kandyse McClure and Paul Sorvino. Its plot draws heavily on the 1981 neo-noir Body Heat, reworking the story of seduction, murder and betrayal around a teenage protagonist.

Doug Martin, a seventeen-year-old, is spending the summer with his parents at their lake house. When Elliot Harper, a wealthy investment banker, moves in next door with his much younger wife, Lena, Doug is instantly attracted to her. Elliot hires Doug to work on his sailboat, which gives him the opportunity to spend time near Lena, who is often left alone while her husband travels on business. Soon Lena and Doug begin a secret affair. She gives him a prepaid phone so they can communicate in secret and repeatedly warns him about Elliot's jealousy and violent temper, showing him bruises she says her husband inflicted.

One night Lena calls Doug to her house, where he finds Elliot dead on the floor. She claims that her husband attacked her and that she killed him accidentally while defending herself. Frightened, Doug agrees to help her cover up her role in the death. Soon afterward, an insurance investigator, Angie Alvarez, arrives to examine the circumstances surrounding the ten-million-dollar life insurance policy that Lena stands to collect, and the local sheriff also begins asking questions. As suspicion increasingly falls on him, Doug starts to realize that he may have been manipulated from the very beginning and that Lena's version of events may be designed to make him the perfect scapegoat.

The film borrows the femme fatale and murder-plot conventions of classic film noir while placing them in a sun-soaked summer setting with a young cast.

Careful What You Wish For was released by Starz Digital on June 10, 2016. It was poorly received, holding an approval rating of 17 percent on Rotten Tomatoes, whose consensus criticized its stale plotting and curious lack of sensuality.

title: A la mala

overview: Maria Laura "Mala" is an actress with little luck, but she is successful working for other women, seducing their boyfriends to know if they are faithful or not. plot:
A la mala (Spanish for "by foul means") is a 2015 Mexican romantic comedy film directed by Pedro Pablo Ibarra and written by Issa López and Ari Rosen. Starring Aislinn Derbez and Mauricio Ochmann, it was produced with Videocine and released by Pantelion Films, opening simultaneously in Mexico and the United States on 27 February 2015. Its tagline promised a heroine who is good precisely when she is bad.

Derbez plays María Laura Medina, nicknamed "Mala", a talented but luckless actress who, disillusioned with men and unable to find acting work, earns a living by putting her skills to a different use. Hired by women who suspect their boyfriends, she adopts a series of disguises, accents and personas to seduce the men and expose whether they are unfaithful, concluding from experience that virtually all men are weak. Her big break finally seems to arrive when an important producer offers her the lead in a television series, but on one condition: Mala must make the producer's ex-boyfriend fall in love with her and then make him pay for all the suffering he caused.

The target is Santiago (Ochmann), a wealthy businessman whom Mala cannot stand at first and who appears to be an arrogant boor with no interest in the arts. As she works her way into his life, Santiago breaks the pattern she has come to expect, revealing a hidden side as a musician and philanthropist and opening up to her about his past. Mala's professional convictions are shaken as she realises she is falling for him, and she must decide whether to complete the job that could launch her career. Her friends Kika (Aurora Papile) and Pablo (Luis Arrieta) provide comic support, while Daniela Schmidt plays the scheming Patricia; the cast also features Juan Diego Covarrubias, José Ron and Iván Sánchez, with a cameo by Eugenio Derbez.

The film was a substantial commercial success in Mexico, where Televisa reported that it had grossed more than 112 million pesos within three weeks, ranking among the most successful Mexican films of recent years; in the United States and Canada it earned about 3.6 million dollars. Critical reception was mixed. Francisco Salazar of Latin Post called it entertaining though hardly groundbreaking, praising the chemistry of the leads, Derbez's versatility in her disguises and the supporting comedians while faulting its frantic cutting to close-ups, and The News Tribune felt that a formulaic middle section spoiled a promising start and a satisfying finish.

title: The Big Short
tagline: This is a true story.
overview: The men who made millions from a global economic meltdown.
plot:
The Big Short is a biographical comedy-drama film directed by Adam McKay, released in 2015 by Paramount Pictures. The movie is based on the 2010 book of the same name by Michael Lewis, which chronicles the 2008 financial crisis from the perspective of several individuals who predicted and profited from the collapse.

The film begins with a series of vignettes introducing us to four main characters: Mark Baum (played by Christian Bale), a Wall Street trader; Charlie Geller (played by John Magaro) and Jamie Shipley (played by Finn Wittrock), two young investors; and Dr. Michael Burry (played by Steve Carell), an eccentric hedge fund manager.

In 2005, the housing market is booming, and subprime mortgages are being aggressively marketed to unsuspecting homeowners. Baum, Geller, and Shipley, who have lost their jobs in the financial industry, stumble upon a lucrative investment opportunity: buying mortgage-backed securities (MBS) that are based on these subprime loans.

However, Dr. Burry, an outcast among his peers, has been warning about the impending doom of the housing market for years. He believes that the subprime mortgages will default en masse, causing a catastrophic collapse in the financial system. Despite being ridiculed and dismissed by his colleagues, Burry's predictions are eerily accurate.

As the story unfolds, we see how each character becomes increasingly convinced that the housing market is about to implode. Baum, Geller, and Shipley start buying MBS, while Dr. Burry creates a credit default swap (CDS) to hedge against the potential losses. The CDS allows them to profit from the collapse of the subprime mortgages.

The plot thickens as the characters navigate the complex web of financial instruments and regulatory loopholes that enabled the crisis. They face resistance from their colleagues, who are more interested in making money than warning about the impending disaster.

As the housing market begins to decline, the characters' fortunes change dramatically. Baum's firm is on the verge of bankruptcy, while Dr. Burry's CDS becomes a lucrative investment. The film culminates with the collapse of Lehman Brothers and the subsequent financial crisis.

Throughout the movie, McKay uses satire and humor to critique the excesses of Wall Street and the failures of regulatory oversight. The film features an all-star cast, including Ryan Gosling as Jared Vennett, a Deutsche Bank trader who becomes Dr. Burry's partner in crime.

The Big Short is a thought-provoking and entertaining film that sheds light on one of the most significant financial crises in modern history. By following the stories of these four characters, we gain a deeper understanding of how the crisis unfolded and how some individuals were able to profit from it. The movie ends with a sense of irony and outrage, as the characters reflect on the consequences of their actions and the failures of the system that enabled them.

Overall, The Big Short is a gripping and informative film that provides valuable insights into the world of high finance and the human factors that drive economic behavior.

title: Cobain: Montage of Heck
overview: Hailed as one of the most innovative and intimate documentaries of all time, experience Kurt Cobain like never before in the only ever fully authorized portrait of the famed music icon. Academy Award nominated filmmaker Brett Morgen expertly blends Cobain's personal archive of art, music, never seen before movies, animation and revelatory interviews from his family and closest friends.
plot:
Cobain: Montage of Heck is a poignant and introspective documentary that delves into the life of Kurt Cobain, the iconic lead singer of Nirvana. The film masterfully weaves together fragments of Cobain's childhood, his rise to fame, and his struggles with mental health, addiction, and the pressures of stardom.

At its core, the movie is a deeply personal exploration of the human condition, tackling themes of identity, creativity, and the fragility of the human psyche. Through Cobain's story, the documentary sheds light on the darker aspects of fame, revealing the toll it takes on individuals who are thrust into the spotlight at an early age.

The film also touches on the complexities of family dynamics, particularly the strained relationship between Kurt and his father, Donald, a Vietnam War veteran struggling with PTSD. This tension serves as a microcosm for Cobain's own struggles with anxiety, depression, and feelings of disconnection.

Furthermore, Montage of Heck is a powerful examination of the blurred lines between creativity and madness. Cobain's artistic expression – both through music and visual art – is portrayed as a means of coping with the turmoil that plagued his life. The documentary suggests that this creative outlet was both a source of solace and a double-edged sword, capable of bringing both comfort and chaos.

Ultimately, Cobain: Montage of Heck is a heart-wrenching tribute to a complex and multifaceted individual, one whose struggles with mental health and addiction continue to resonate with audiences today. The film serves as a poignant reminder that even the most brilliant minds can be fragile and vulnerable, and that the pressures of fame can have devastating consequences when left unchecked.

title: Ratter
tagline: At this moment someone could be listening... watching... recording...
overview: Emma is a young and beautiful graduate student just starting a new life in New York City. Like most people her age, she is always connected - her phone and laptop are constant companions, documenting her most intimate moments. What she doesn't realize is that she's sharing her life with an uninvited and dangerous guest. A hacker is following Emma’s every move. When the voyeuristic thrill of watching her digitally isn't enough, the situation escalates to a dangerous and terrifying level.
plot:
Ratter is a 2015 American found-footage horror thriller written and directed by Branden Kramer, making his feature debut. It expands Webcam, a short film that Kramer wrote and co-directed, and is presented in found-footage style. The film premiered at the Slamdance Film Festival on January 24, 2015. In October 2015 Sony Pictures Worldwide Acquisitions bought its global distribution rights, and it opened in a limited release through Destination Films and Vertical Entertainment on February 12, 2016.

Graduate student Emma Taylor moves to a Brooklyn apartment in New York City for a fresh start after breaking up with her boyfriend, Alex. Soon an anonymous stranger hacks into all of her electronic devices and begins watching her through their cameras. At school she meets Michael, and they start dating, but the hacker steals intimate images of the couple and sends Emma messages and videos while posing as Michael. Emma accuses him, refuses to believe his denials and pulls away. After a night out with her best friend Nicole, she comes home drunk and falls asleep, unaware that the intruder has entered the apartment and is waiting on her balcony.

Michael visits with a cat to keep her company and the couple reconcile, but he later tells her that someone emailed him a warning to stay away from her. The police do nothing, and Emma grows isolated and depressed. Returning home one day to an unlocked door, she finds her cat dead, and Michael does not answer her calls. Frightened, she spends the day wandering the city before going back to wait for Nicole. During a video call with her mother, the power goes out and the stalker attacks Emma while the call is still connected. Her screams stop, her mother calls the police and begs the man to leave her daughter alone, and he turns the laptop toward himself before closing it. The film ends as police search for the missing Emma.

Ashley Benson stars as Emma and Matt McGorry as Michael, with Rebecca Naomi Jones as Nicole, Kalli Vernoff and Ted Koch as Emma's parents, Michael William Freeman as Alex and Karl Glusman as Brent. Its reported earnings come from DVD and Blu-ray sales, which totaled $110,834.

title: Dark Phoenix
tagline: The Phoenix will rise.
overview: The X-Men face their most formidable and powerful foe when one of their own, Jean Grey, starts to spiral out of control. During a rescue mission in outer space, Jean is nearly killed when she's hit by a mysterious cosmic force. Once she returns home, this force not only makes her infinitely more powerful, but far more unstable. The X-Men must now band together to save her soul and battle aliens that want to use Grey's new abilities to rule the galaxy.
plot:
Dark Phoenix is a 2019 superhero film directed by Simon Kinberg, based on the Marvel Comics storyline of the same name. The movie serves as a sequel to X-Men: Apocalypse and follows the story of Jean Grey (played by Sophie Turner), one of the most powerful mutants in the X-Men universe.

The film begins with Jean Grey, now married to Cyclops (James McAvoy) and expecting their first child. However, during a mission to stop the mutant-hunting Sentinels, Jean is exposed to a massive amount of cosmic energy from the Black Hole that Apocalypse had created earlier. This energy transforms her into the powerful being known as Dark Phoenix.

As Jean struggles to control her newfound powers, she becomes increasingly isolated and withdrawn from her friends and family. Cyclops tries to help her, but his attempts only lead to more conflict between them. Meanwhile, a group of mutants, including Storm (Alexandra Shipp), Nightcrawler (Kodi Smit-McPhee), and Jean's friend, Forge (Tye Sheridan), try to find a way to stop Dark Phoenix before she destroys the Earth.

As the situation escalates, Jean becomes more and more consumed by her powers, leading to a catastrophic event that causes widespread destruction. The X-Men are forced to go into hiding, and Cyclops is left to deal with the aftermath of his wife's transformation.

The film takes a dramatic turn when Dark Phoenix, now fully embracing her powers, sets her sights on the sun, intending to harness its energy to save humanity from the Sentinels. However, this plan ultimately leads to her own destruction and the near-destruction of the Earth.

In the end, Jean is able to find redemption by sacrificing herself to save the world from Dark Phoenix's destructive power. The movie concludes with Cyclops, who has come to terms with his wife's sacrifice, finding a way to move forward and start a new life without her.

Throughout the film, Sophie Turner delivers a powerful performance as Jean Grey, bringing depth and nuance to the character. The supporting cast, including James McAvoy, Jessica Chastain, and Michael Fassbender, also deliver strong performances that add to the overall tension and drama of the story.

Overall, Dark Phoenix is a thought-provoking and visually stunning film that explores themes of power, identity, and sacrifice. While it received mixed reviews from critics, fans of the X-Men franchise will appreciate the movie's faithful adaptation of the comic book storyline and its emotional depth.

title: Hello, My Name Is Doris
tagline: She's not ready to act her age
overview: A self-help seminar inspires a sixty-something woman to romantically pursue her younger co-worker.
plot:
Hello, My Name Is Doris is a 2015 American romantic comedy-drama film that explores several poignant and relatable themes. At its core, the movie delves into the complexities of identity, self-discovery, and the human need for connection.

The protagonist, Doris, played by Sally Field, is a shy and introverted woman who struggles to find her place in the world. Her journey is marked by a series of awkward encounters and misadventures, which serve as a catalyst for her growth and transformation. As she navigates through various relationships and experiences, Doris begins to confront her own insecurities and limitations, ultimately leading her to reevaluate her sense of self.

One of the primary themes of the film is the importance of embracing one's true nature and accepting oneself for who they are. Doris's journey is a powerful metaphor for the human experience, as she learns to let go of societal expectations and forge her own path in life. This theme is beautifully captured through Field's nuanced performance, which brings depth and vulnerability to the character.

The movie also explores the concept of loneliness and isolation, highlighting the struggles that many people face in their personal lives. Doris's relationships with others are often fraught with awkwardness and misunderstandings, but ultimately, she comes to realize that true connection requires vulnerability and openness.

Furthermore, Hello, My Name Is Doris touches on the theme of female empowerment and self-discovery, particularly in the context of midlife crises. The film offers a refreshing and humorous take on this universal experience, showcasing Doris's growth from an uncertain and insecure individual to a confident and self-assured person.

Overall, Hello, My Name Is Doris is a heartwarming and thought-provoking film that explores the complexities of human relationships, identity, and personal growth.

title: Sky Sharks
tagline: In a shark no one can hear you scream.
overview: A team of Arctic geologists stumble across an abandoned laboratory in which the Nazis developed an incredible and brutal secret weapon during the final months of WW2. Deep in the ice, they accidentally awake a deadly army of flying zombie sharks ridden by genetically mutated, undead super-humans, who are unleashed into the skies, wreaking their bloodthirsty revenge on any aircraft that takes to the air. An elite task force is assembled to take on this deadly threat and stop the Sky Sharks from conquering the air, but as time runs out, the task force realises they will have to fight fire with fire, and the stage is set for the greatest flying super-mutant zombie shark air battle the world has ever seen....
plot:
Sky Sharks is a 2020 German science fiction comedy horror film directed by Marc Fehse. Deliberately conceived as an over-the-top B-movie, it features an international cast of genre performers including Thomas Morris, Barbara Nedeljakova, Eva Habermann, Michaela Schaffrath, Tony Todd, Robert LaSardo, Cary-Hiroyuki Tagawa, Lynn Lowry, Lar Park Lincoln and Nick Principe. The production was partly financed through a Kickstarter campaign launched in 2015, and after years of work on its visual effects, it was released in 2020, screening at genre festivals including London's FrightFest.

During an expedition in the polar ice, a team of geologists accidentally uncovers a secret Nazi laboratory from the Second World War, hidden for decades deep beneath the ice. Inside lies a terrifying secret weapon developed in the final years of the war: an army of genetically modified flying sharks, ridden by superhuman undead Nazi soldiers who were created through monstrous experiments. When the long-dormant creatures are awakened, they take to the skies, attacking aircraft and slaughtering everyone in their path, threatening to unleash destruction on the modern world.

At the center of the story is the scientist Dr. Klaus Richter, whose family is connected to the wartime project, and his daughters, Diabla and Angelique, who become key to stopping the threat. As the sky sharks spread terror around the globe, an elite military unit is assembled to confront them, made up of American soldiers who had fallen in the Vietnam War. The film moves between the present-day battle and flashbacks to the project's origins, piling on aerial dogfights, gory set pieces and outrageous violence as the heroes race to destroy the undead army and save the planet from annihilation.

Sky Sharks received mixed reviews, with a 50 percent rating on Rotten Tomatoes based on six reviews. Martin Unsworth of Starburst gave it three stars, describing it as the bastard child of Iron Sky and Dead Snow that lets the audience have fun with its Nazi premise. Critics praised its gory effects, which looked impressive for its modest budget, and its self-aware absurdity, but criticized its disjointed plot, repetitive flashbacks, thin characters and gratuitous nudity.

title: The Boy
tagline: Every child needs to feel loved.
overview: An American nanny is shocked that her new English family's boy is actually a life-sized doll. After she violates a list of strict rules, disturbing events make her believe that the doll is really alive.
plot:
The Boy is a 2016 horror film directed by William Brent Bell and written by Stacey Menear. It stars Lauren Cohan and Rupert Evans alongside Jim Norton, Diana Hardcastle and James Russell. An international co-production between China and the United States, it was filmed in Victoria, British Columbia, beginning in March 2015, and was released by STXfilms on January 22, 2016. A sequel, Brahms: The Boy II, followed in 2020.

Greta Evans, an American travelling in the United Kingdom whose abusive ex-boyfriend Cole has been trying to find out where she is, takes a job as a nanny for the elderly Heelshires at their remote English house. Her charge turns out to be Brahms, a doll that the couple treat as their real son. Before leaving on holiday, they give Greta a strict list of rules for looking after him, which she promptly ignores. From Malcolm, the young man who delivers the family's groceries, she learns that the real Brahms died in a fire twenty years earlier, on his eighth birthday, and that he was considered an odd child. Soon unsettling things begin to happen: her clothes and jewelry disappear, she is trapped in the attic, the doll seems to move when she is not in the room, and a child's voice promises to be good. Greta begins to follow the rules carefully and comes to believe that Brahms's spirit inhabits the doll. Malcolm then tells her that a girl who played with Brahms was found dead in the forest before the fire, and he urges Greta to leave, but she feels bound to stay. Matters reach a crisis when Cole tracks her down and arrives at the house, demanding that she return to America with him, and the secret that the Heelshires have been hiding behind the walls of their home finally comes to light.

The Boy received mixed to negative reviews. On Rotten Tomatoes it has a 31% approval rating, with a consensus that it settles for routine jump scares within a pedestrian plot, and Metacritic gives it a score of 42 out of 100. Commercially it was a success, grossing about $73.9 million worldwide against a production budget of $10 million.

title: The Man with the Iron Fists 2
original_title: The Man with the Iron Fists 2
overview: When a stranger, Thaddeus, is found badly wounded near the village, miner Li Kung and his wife Ah Ni offer him refuge. As he heals, he becomes entrenched in a conflict that pits the townsfolk against the evil Master Ho, his nefarious Beetle Clan and the terrifying Lord Pi.
plot:
The Man with the Iron Fists 2 is a 2015 American direct-to-video martial arts action film directed by Roel Reiné and written by RZA and John Jarrell. A sequel to the 2012 film The Man with the Iron Fists, it stars RZA as Thaddeus, the blacksmith with iron fists, along with Sahajak Boonthanakit, Pim Bubear, Ocean Hou, Grace Huang, Andrew Lin, Khiri Steven Lowenstein, Dustin Nguyen, Eugenia Yuan and Cary-Hiroyuki Tagawa. It was released on DVD and Blu-ray in April 2015.

Thaddeus is traveling to the monks of the Wu Chi Temple in search of inner peace when he is ambushed by the brother of his old enemy Silver Lion and a band of henchmen. He defeats them but is gravely wounded and passes out, drifting down a river on a log. A narration tells the legend of the Golden Nectar, a spring of chi flowing from the mountains that was protected by monks and the Gemini Twins until the evil Lord Pi tried to seize it; his ghost is said to haunt the mountains, stealing the chi of anyone he meets.

Downstream, Thaddeus is found and nursed back to health by Li Kung, a miner in the village of Tsai Fu, and his family. The village is controlled by the ruthless Master Ho, who owns the local silver mine and treats the workers brutally, maiming or killing those who fall behind, while his henchmen, the Beetle Clan, terrorize the villagers. Young women have been disappearing and turning up dead, and grieving families demand justice. Li Kung, a man who has renounced violence because of his past, is reluctant to resist, but as the abuses grow worse and the villagers begin to organize, Thaddeus is drawn into the conflict. He must help the miners rise up against Master Ho and his fighters, while the mystery of the murdered women and the legend of the Golden Nectar come together in a final battle.

The film received mostly negative reviews. Ignatiy Vishnevetsky of The A.V. Club gave it a C−, writing that while the appeal of the wuxia genre lies in its larger-than-life world, the film, apart from a few gruesome fights and brief fantastical moments, suggested a world duller and cheaper-looking than reality. Kenneth Brown of Blu-ray.com was among the other critics who reviewed its home video release.

title: Beauty and the Beast
tagline: Be our guest.
overview: A live-action adaptation of Disney's version of the classic tale of a cursed prince and a beautiful young woman who helps him break the spell.
plot:
Beauty and the Beast is a 2017 American romantic fantasy film directed by Bill Condon, based on the 1991 animated film of the same name by Walt Disney Pictures. The story is an adaptation of the 1740 French fairy tale "La Belle et la Bête" by Gabrielle-Suzanne Barbot de Villeneuve.

The film begins with a prologue that sets the tone for the rest of the story, showcasing the Beast's (Dan Stevens) transformation from a prince to a monster after he is cursed by an enchantress. The curse states that the Beast will remain in this form until he finds true love and is loved in return.

In the present day, Belle (Emma Watson), a beautiful and intelligent young woman, lives in a small French village with her inventor father, Maurice (Kevin Kline). When Maurice gets lost in the forest while searching for a rare part to repair his latest invention, he stumbles upon the Beast's castle. The Beast, who is initially hostile towards Belle, imprisons Maurice as punishment.

Belle sets out to rescue her father and offers to take his place as the prisoner. She agrees to stay with the Beast in exchange for her father's freedom. As she spends more time with the Beast, she begins to see beyond his physical appearance and discovers a kind and intelligent person beneath the surface.

The Beast, who is struggling to come to terms with his curse, is initially resistant to Belle's charms but eventually warms up to her. They begin to form a bond, and Belle learns about the Beast's past and the reason for his transformation. The Beast tells Belle that he was once a prince who was cursed by an enchantress as punishment for his arrogance.

As Belle and the Beast spend more time together, they develop feelings for each other. However, their love is threatened when Gaston (Luke Evans), a vain and egotistical hunter, arrives in the village with plans to kill the Beast and win Belle's hand in marriage.

In the climactic final act, Gaston and his mob attack the castle, and Belle must defend her home and the Beast. In the process, she saves the Beast from Gaston's knife and ultimately breaks the curse by confessing her love for him.

The film ends with the Beast transformed back into a prince, and he and Belle share a romantic dance at the ball. The movie concludes on a hopeful note, suggesting that the two can build a life together despite their differences.

Overall, Beauty and the Beast is a beautifully crafted tale of love, acceptance, and redemption. The film features stunning visuals, memorable characters, and a timeless story that has captivated audiences for centuries.

title: Steve Jobs
tagline: Can a great man be a good man?
overview: Set backstage at three iconic product launches and ending in 1998 with the unveiling of the iMac, Steve Jobs takes us behind the scenes of the digital revolution to paint an intimate portrait of the brilliant man at its epicenter.
plot:
Steve Jobs is a British-American biographical drama of 2015 directed by Danny Boyle and written by Aaron Sorkin, adapted from Walter Isaacson's 2011 biography. It spans fourteen years in the life of the Apple co-founder, from the Macintosh in 1984 to the iMac in 1998. Michael Fassbender plays Jobs, with Kate Winslet as the marketing executive Joanna Hoffman, Seth Rogen as Steve Wozniak, Jeff Daniels as Apple's chief executive John Sculley, Katherine Waterston as Chrisann Brennan and Michael Stuhlbarg as Andy Hertzfeld.

In 1984, less than an hour before the Macintosh is unveiled at the Flint Center, its voice demonstration breaks down. Jobs bullies Hertzfeld, who fakes the demo with a prototype. He rants to Hoffman about a Time article on his paternity dispute, denying he is the father of her five-year-old daughter Lisa. Brennan arrives with the girl, bitter at his refusal to support them, but Jobs connects with Lisa over a picture she draws in MacPaint and agrees to more money and a house. Wozniak asks him to thank the Apple II team on stage, and Jobs, considering the machine obsolete, declines.

By 1988, after the Macintosh's disappointing sales, Jobs has been pushed out of Apple and is about to launch the NeXT Computer at the War Memorial Opera House. He spends time with nine-year-old Lisa but quarrels with Brennan over money. Wozniak predicts another flop and questions Jobs's contribution; Jobs casts himself as a conductor. Sculley wants to know why the public believes he fired Jobs; in fact the board ousted him after he defied them and forced a vote on his future. Hoffman realizes the NeXT machine is designed to lure Apple into buying the company and bringing him back.

In 1998, with Sculley gone and NeXT acquired, Jobs is Apple's chief executive and about to present the iMac at Davies Symphony Hall. The film's main theme revolves around the notion that reality is fragile and can be easily distorted by external forces. The Bizarro League, a parallel universe where everything is opposite to its counterpart in the Justice League universe, serves as a metaphor for the fragility of reality. This concept is further reinforced by the character of Bizarro himself, who struggles with his own identity and sense of belonging.

The movie also touches on the idea that even those who seem like outcasts or misfits can find their place within society. The character of Bizarro, despite being a flawed and imperfect version of Superman, ultimately finds acceptance and belonging among his peers in the Bizarro League.

Furthermore, the film highlights the importance of teamwork and cooperation in overcoming adversity. The Justice League must work together to defeat the Bizarro League and restore balance to the multiverse, demonstrating that even the most unlikely allies can come together to achieve a common goal.

Overall, LEGO DC Comics Super Heroes: Justice League vs. Bizarro League (2015) is a lighthearted and entertaining film that explores complex themes in an accessible and engaging way.

Through her prayers, Missy receives wisdom and encouragement from God, which she shares with Jonathan. As they work through their issues together, their relationship begins to heal and grow stronger.

Meanwhile, Felicity faces her own struggles, including a difficult marriage and feelings of isolation. Through her conversations with Missy, she is reminded of the importance of prayer and seeking God's guidance in all areas of life.

Overall, War Room is a heartwarming and inspiring film that explores the importance of prayer, communication, and faith in relationships. With its uplifting message and strong performances from the cast, it has become a beloved Christian movie that continues to resonate with audiences today.

plot:
Hangman is a 2017 American crime thriller directed by Johnny Martin and written by Charles Huttinger and Michael Caissie. It stars Al Pacino as retired homicide detective Ray Archer and Karl Urban as Detective Will Ruiney, with Brittany Snow as journalist Christi Davies, Sarah Shahi as Captain Lisa Watson and Joe Anderson as the killer. The story follows two detectives hunting a serial killer who stages his murders after the children's word-guessing game Hangman.

In Monroe, Georgia, Detective Ray Archer confronts the driver of a hit-and-run van and notices a gothic pendant hanging from its mirror. A year later, Christi Davies, a reporter who has been allowed to shadow the police for a story, accompanies Detective Ruiney to a gruesome crime scene: a teacher has been hanged outside her school with a letter carved into her chest. Inside a classroom the killer has staged a game of Hangman between two mannequins and carved the badge numbers of Ruiney and Archer into a desk, making it clear that the detectives have been chosen as his opponents.

Although retired, Archer joins the investigation, and the two detectives, with Davies in tow, follow a trail of clues that leads them through the victim's private life and to a church where the killer strikes again. Each body is marked with a new letter, and the detectives realize that the murderer intends to keep killing, with a new letter for each victim, until the game's puzzle is complete. Racing against the clock, they must decipher the hidden word, uncover the killer's identity and his connection to their own pasts, and protect the people close to them, especially Ruiney, who is still haunted by the unsolved murder of his wife.

The film draws on the conventions of serial-killer thrillers, combining a police procedural with a puzzle-based mystery.

Hangman was released in the United States on December 22, 2017. It received overwhelmingly negative reviews, with an approval rating of 5 percent on Rotten Tomatoes and a Metacritic score of 31, and critics found its plot contrived despite the presence of Pacino.

title: The Corpse of Anna Fritz
overview: Anna Fritz is a beautiful and famous actress. Suddenly her body is found in a hotel and the news of her death goes around the planet. plot:
The Corpse of Anna Fritz (Spanish: El cadáver de Anna Fritz) is a 2015 Spanish thriller co-written and directed by Hèctor Hernández Vicens. It stars Alba Ribas as Anna Fritz, Albert Carbó as Pau, Cristian Valencia as Ivan and Bernat Saumell as Javi, with Nico Avila as a doctor. Set almost entirely within a hospital morgue during a single night, it is a claustrophobic and disturbing story about guilt, complicity and survival.

Pau works as an orderly in a hospital, a job that gives him access to the bodies brought to the morgue. One night the body of Anna Fritz, a famous and much-admired young actress who has died suddenly, is brought in. Unable to resist, Pau takes a photograph and sends it to his friends Ivan and Javi, who come to the hospital to see the body for themselves. Egged on by the domineering Ivan, Pau and Ivan commit a horrific crime against the corpse, while Javi, disgusted, refuses to take part.

In the middle of the assault, the men realize to their horror that Anna has opened her eyes: she is alive, but paralyzed and unable to speak. The three are now faced with a terrible choice: to seek medical help and face the consequences of what they have done, or to kill her to cover up their crime. Javi insists that they must save her and take responsibility, while Ivan is determined to silence her and persuades the weak-willed Pau that they have no choice. Their argument turns violent, with fatal consequences. As the men debate her fate, Anna gradually regains control of her body, and the night turns into a desperate struggle in which she must find a way to escape from the morgue alive.

With few characters and a single location, the film builds tension from the moral collapse of its characters and from the perspective of a victim who cannot move or call for help.

The Corpse of Anna Fritz premiered at the South by Southwest festival in Austin, Texas, on 15 March 2015. Reviews were mixed to positive, with about 67 percent approval on Rotten Tomatoes. IGN's Cliff Wheatley praised Alba Ribas's performance and the tense subject matter, though he felt that even its 76-minute running time was too long, while the International Business Times thought it might have worked better as a short film.

James agrees, but only if Ben can pass a series of tests designed to gauge his worthiness.

As the story unfolds, Ben and James embark on a series of misadventures through Atlanta, from a high-speed chase to a shootout with gang members. Along the way, they encounter a range of colorful characters, including a corrupt cop (John Leguizamo) and a seductive nightclub singer (Andrea Navedo).

Throughout the movie, Ben's antics often put him at odds with James, who is determined to keep his past a secret from Angela. However, as the story progresses, it becomes clear that James' intentions are not entirely pure, and he has ulterior motives for wanting to marry Angela.

As the wedding day approaches, Ben must confront his own insecurities and prove himself worthy of marrying Angela. In the end, he succeeds in passing James' tests and earning his respect, but not before a dramatic showdown with James' gang members.

The movie ends with Ben and Angela's wedding ceremony taking place, surrounded by their friends and family. However, just as they're about to exchange vows, James makes a shocking revelation: he's been working undercover to take down the gang from the inside. The movie concludes on a hopeful note, with Ben and Angela finally able to start their life together.

title: Jason Bourne
tagline: You know his name
overview: The most dangerous former operative of the CIA is drawn out of hiding to uncover hidden truths about his past.
plot:
Jason Bourne is a 2016 American action thriller directed and co-produced by Paul Greengrass, who co-wrote the screenplay with Christopher Rouse. The fifth installment of the Bourne series and a direct sequel to The Bourne Ultimatum (2007), it stars Matt Damon, who also co-produced, returning as former CIA assassin Jason Bourne, with Tommy Lee Jones as CIA director Robert Dewey, Alicia Vikander as cyber operations chief Heather Lee, Vincent Cassel as a CIA assassin known as the Asset, Riz Ahmed and Julia Stiles as Nicky Parsons.

Years after exposing the CIA's covert Blackbriar program, Jason Bourne lives off the grid, earning money as a bare-knuckle fighter in Greece while still haunted by fragments of his past. In Reykjavík, his former ally Nicky Parsons, now working with a hacktivist group, breaks into CIA servers to expose the agency's black operations and discovers files about Bourne's recruitment into the Treadstone program and the role played by his father. She travels to Athens to tell him what she has found.

The breach alerts Heather Lee and Director Dewey, who send teams after Bourne and Parsons, along with the Asset, a ruthless assassin who blames Bourne for his capture and torture years earlier. During a violent anti-government protest in Athens, Parsons is killed, leaving Bourne with the key to the stolen files. His search for the truth leads him to Berlin, where he learns that his father, Richard Webb, was a CIA analyst involved in creating Treadstone. Meanwhile, Dewey is pressuring Aaron Kalloor, the founder of the social media company Deep Dream, to give the CIA secret access to its users' data. As Lee begins to see Bourne as a possible asset rather than a target, Bourne pursues the people responsible for his father's death to a technology convention in Las Vegas, where a climactic confrontation unfolds.

The film reflects contemporary concerns about surveillance, privacy and the relationship between intelligence agencies and technology companies, while retaining Greengrass's handheld, documentary-like style.

Jason Bourne was released in July 2016 and was a commercial success, grossing about 416.2 million dollars worldwide against a 120 million dollar budget. Reviews were mixed, with 55 percent approval on Rotten Tomatoes and a Metacritic score of 58.
